sub.title: Episode 1
sub.description: Alvida pirates plunder a ship only to find a barrel containing a strange boy names Luffy who is on a quest to find the legendary One Piece and become the King of Pirates.

sub.title: Episode 2
sub.description: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

sub.title: Episode 3
sub.description: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.

sub.title: Episode 4
sub.description: Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.

sub.title: Episode 5
sub.description: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she’s perfect for Luffy’s new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

sub.title: Episode 6
sub.description: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy’s pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.

sub.title: Episode 7
sub.description: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy's pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.

sub.title: Episode 8
sub.description: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.

sub.title: Episode 9
sub.description: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates' efforts to save her with a ship to call their own - the Going Merry!

sub.title: Episode 10
sub.description: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.

sub.title: Episode 11
sub.description: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world's greatest swordsman - but tragedy intervened.

sub.title: Episode 12
sub.description: The Straw Hats need a cook among their crew, so they head to a nearby restaurant and meet a passionate Sous Chef named Sanji.

sub.title: Episode 13
sub.description: Luffy witnesses the fighting prowess and compassionate nature of the Sous Chef Sanji. The good news: The Going Merry's found a cook! The bad news: He has no intention of joining the crew!

sub.title: Episode 14
sub.description: The staff and patrons of the Baratie panic when Don Krieg arrives! The starving pirate begs for nourishment, only to find himself denied. Unable to see a wretch starve, Sanji steps in once again.

sub.title: Episode 15
sub.description: Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!

sub.title: Episode 16
sub.description: The Going Merry's been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action's not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!

sub.title: Episode 17
sub.description: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg's pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren't looking too good!

sub.title: Episode 18
sub.description: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

sub.title: Episode 19
sub.description: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

sub.title: Episode 20
sub.description: The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.

sub.title: Episode 21
sub.description: The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent's weaponry.

sub.title: Episode 22
sub.description: With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.

sub.title: Episode 23
sub.description:
Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 24
sub.description:
The Going Merry`s been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action`s not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 25
sub.description:
The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg`s pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren`t looking too good!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 26
sub.description:
Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 27
sub.description:
As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 28
sub.description:
The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 29
sub.description:
The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent`s weaponry.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 30
sub.description:
With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 31
sub.description:
With their culinary concerns in good hands, the Straw Hats set off in search of Nami - who`s on a collision course with a deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 32
sub.description:
Zoro is captured by Fishman Arlong and learns a shocking secret about Nami. Unable to believe his ears, he puts the navigator to the ultimate test.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 33
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew make their way towards Arlong Park and a showdown with its fishy proprietor. Along the way, they discover a treasure map that raises more questions about Nami.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 34
sub.description:
A fierce argument over where Nami`s loyalties lie divides the Straw Hat Pirates and only one thing`s for sure - no one is willing to risk their life for a traitor.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 35
sub.description:
Nami`s adopted sister, Nojiko arrives to fill in some details about the skilled mapmaker`s younger days.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 36
sub.description:
Nojiko continues the story of Nami`s younger days. Back in the present, Nami gets agonizingly close to a long time goal, but betrayal looms on the horizon.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 37
sub.description:
Nezumi comes to confiscate Nami`s treasure, but who`s he working for? More importantly, who`s Nami working for, and what`s she gonna do with her booty?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 38
sub.description:
The Straw Hats` faith in Nami is restored, and now it`s time for a battle royal! Luffy and the gang are determined to make Arlong pay for mistreating their friend.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 39
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and Arlong`s fishmen are locked in a swashbuckling slugfest, but things take a bad turn when Luffy gets trapped beneath the waves.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 40
sub.description:
While his friends work to free the captain of the Straw Hats, cowardly Usopp finds himself in a position to shed his yellow streak and make his father proud.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 41
sub.description:
Nami must decide between letting Arlong maintain his hold over her, or joining the Straw Hats and leading the oppressed villagers against the tyrant fishman.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 42
sub.description:
Arlong better watch his back-fins, because Captain Luffy knows about all the horrible things he did to Nami - and it makes his blood boil?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 43
sub.description:
Something about Nami`s former prison gives Luffy an added burst of strength. He`s so moved by her terrible past that he vows to destroy all of Arlong Park!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 44
sub.description:
After a grueling fight, Luffy defeats Arlong and succeeds in destroying his headquarters. The merry marauders enjoy the fruits of victory while Nami makes peace with her turbulent past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 45
sub.description:
Finally, the day has arrived where Luffy`s face is on an authentic wanted poster! Now there are enemies in hot pursuit as the crew makes waves for Logue Town - final resting place of Gold Roger!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 46
sub.description:
Buggy gets marooned on an island inhabited by unusual creatures and tangles with the island`s caretaker, Gaimon. If he is to finally destroy Luffy, Buggy must cast his lot with a mysterious woman.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 47
sub.description:
The Buggy Pirates fight each other for the right to take their lost captain`s place. While they`re busy beating each other`s brains out, a cannibalistic tribe makes plans to have something special for dinner.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 48
sub.description:
The Straw Hats arrive at Logue Town, and each crewmember embarks upon a mission of a more personal nature. While his crew shops, Luffy goes in search of sacred ground.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 49
sub.description:
Luffy has a run-in with Captain Smoker, and his failure to keep a low profile helps Buggy draw a bead on him. Elsewhere, Zoro takes a chance that his skill can overcome a dangerous curse.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 50
sub.description:
Usopp finds an amazing pair of sharpshooter`s goggles, but they lead to a run in with Daddy the Parent - the greatest gunslinger ever! Now, the Straw Hat marksman is headed for the deadliest of all duels.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 51
sub.description:
A cooking competition with the fiery chef Carmen rekindles Sanji`s dreams of the legendary All Blue.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 52
sub.description:
Buggy and his mysterious female ally trap Luffy on the same platform where Gold Roger was executed. He is to be killed for his offenses against Buggy, but Zoro and Sanji attempt a daring rescue mission.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 53
sub.description:
As a storm batters Logue Town, Buggy, Alvida, and Captain Smoker close in on Luffy for a stirring final showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 54
sub.description:
The discovery of a small girl adrift in an abandoned life boat interrupts Luffy and his crew`s voyage to the Grand Line.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 55
sub.description:
After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament - stranded in the Calm Belt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 56
sub.description:
The Straw Hats want to return Apis`s dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it`s time for another daring escape!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 57
sub.description:
Even for Nami, finding the dragon`s lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack - or at the bottom of the ocean.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 58
sub.description:
Nami discovers a map to the true location of the dragon`s nest, and Zorro puts his steel to the test against Eric the Whirlwind.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 59
sub.description:
The Straw Hats sail headfirst into Commodore Nelson and his Marine armada. While Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro dodge cannon balls, Eric the Whirlwind prepares a sneak attack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 60
sub.description:
With their rescue mission taking on water, the Straw Hats get some surprising help from the great blue yonder.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 61
sub.description:
After unlocking the secrets of the dragon`s nest, Luffy does battle with Eric the Whirlwind to ensure the safety of the island. Don`t mess with the rubberman!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 62
sub.description:
The Straw Hat crew takes a wild ride up and down a mountain only to end up in the belly of a giant whale that`s on the lookout for pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 63
sub.description:
Luffy trades blows with Laboon the whale, and Nami is distressed to learn that navigating the Grand Line is no easy feat.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 64
sub.description:
A violent snow storm batters the crew of the Going Merry, but once the Straw Hats arrive at Whisky Peak, the locals invite them to a raucous celebration.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 65
sub.description:
There are bounty hunters on the prowl, and most of the Straw Hats are dead drunk. Only Zoro is still sober enough to hoist a sword.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 66
sub.description:
There`s a mysterious princess that needs protection from a nose-picking assassin, but Luffy and Zoro are too busy duking it out to worry about explosive boogers.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 67
sub.description:
The Straw Hats depart Whisky Peak on a mission to return the Princess of Alabasta to her kingdom while protecting her from an army of vicious assassins.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 68
sub.description:
While the crew heads for Little Garden with the princess, Luffy and Zorro`s old nemesis, Axe-Hand Morgan, escapes from a Marine prison ship.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 69
sub.description:
Colby and Helmeppo train day and night to prove they`re tough enough to be Marines. A violent showdown with Vice-Admiral Garp will determine if they`re worth their salt.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 70
sub.description:
Luffy`s gang is running low on supplies, so they stop at Little Garden to find something to eat. Unfortunately for them, it might end up the other way around.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 71
sub.description:
Not only are there dinosaurs running wild on the island of Little Garden, but the Straw Hats soon find themselves in the middle of a gargantuan grudge match.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 72
sub.description:
Usopp and Luffy are fascinated by the endless battle waged between Dorry and Broggy; however, fascination turns to outrage when Monkey catches a whiff of treachery.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 73
sub.description:
Luffy`s blood boils for revenge against the assassins who sabotaged Dorry and Broggy`s battle, but he`s currently trapped between a rock and a hard place.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 74
sub.description:
While Luffy struggles to free himself, his friends fall into the hands of Baroque Works. Though the odds are against them, the Straw Hats will never give up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 75
sub.description:
Nami, Zorro, and the Princess are in danger of becoming exhibits in a fiendish artist`s collection, and only Luffy can save them. But he`s busy having a cup of tea.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 76
sub.description:
With his friends about to be permanently entombed in wax, Usopp is provided with the perfect opportunity to be brave and make his father proud.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 77
sub.description:
After narrowly avoiding death, Luffy`s crew and the Princess set sail for Alabasta, but something large and dangerous looms in their path.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 78
sub.description:
Nami comes down with a terrible fever and the Straw Hats don`t know what to do. Looks like the Grand Line might claim another victim.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 79
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue their quest to find a doctor for Nami. Along the way, they deal with a ravenous invader and get a chilly reception from local islanders.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 80
sub.description:
Luffy and Sanji make a bold trek up a snow-covered mountain in search of a witch who might hold the key to curing Nami.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 81
sub.description:
Ferocious, giant, snow rabbits slow Luffy and Sanji`s progress up the mountain. Meanwhile, the former king Wapol returns to the town he abandoned.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 82
sub.description:
Nami hovers near death while Luffy and Sanji fend off the abominable rabbits. Back at the village, Dalton leads a revolt against the dastardly Wapol.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 83
sub.description:
An unlikely source acts as a roadblock to give Luffy some climbing room, and Zorro emerges from a snow bank cold, cranky, and ready to rumble!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 84
sub.description:
After a long journey up the mountain, Nami finally receives much-needed medical attention, but Sanji and Luffy are more interested in eating the doctor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 85
sub.description:
Luffy recruits Tony Tony Chopper to join the Straw Hat crew as the ship`s doctor.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 86
sub.description:
Chopper`s first friend was a quack doctor who couldn`t cure a cold, but the old man still managed to teach the little reindeer how to care for people.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 87
sub.description:
Luffy unleashes the full force of his Gum Gum furry on Wapol, and Chopper is amazed by the rubberman`s fierce devotion to the pirate flag.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 88
sub.description:
When Wapol orders his goons to attack the Straw Hats, Chopper shows off a little something he calls the Rumble Ball!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 89
sub.description:
Wapol attacks Nami in her weakened condition, but Monkey D. Luffy is quick to step in and even the odds.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 90
sub.description:
After an explosive battle with Wapol, Luffy begins the tiring process of convincing Chopper to join his pirate gang.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 91
sub.description:
Chopper sets sail for Alabasta with his new friends, and Dalton thinks back to his first meeting with Princess Vivi.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 92
sub.description:
The Straw Hats rescue a man of many faces as they approach Alabasta. Sure, he`s good for a laugh, but they may regret pulling him out of the drink.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 93
sub.description:
The Straw Hats arrive in Alabasta with precious little time to stop the rebellion. Sanji and Chopper are sent to gather supplies for a dangerous trip across the desert.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 94
sub.description:
Captain Smoker has Luffy in his grasp until a fiery stranger creates a diversion, giving the Straw Hats a chance to make a break for it.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 95
sub.description:
Ace and Luffy`s happy reunion is crudely interrupted by the Billions of Baroque Works. They may be outnumbered, but these brothers are no ordinary pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 96
sub.description:
Before they can start their trek across the desert, Luffy and the Straw Hats are stopped at the shore by the cute - but formidable - Kung Fu Dugongs.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 97
sub.description:
Luffy`s crew encounters treacherous birds and man-eating foliage on its desert odyssey, and just when they think the coast is clear, a great disturbance emerges from beneath the sand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 98
sub.description:
The Straw Hats cross paths with the Barbar Sand Pirates, and Ace runs into big trouble when he gets separated from the group.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 99
sub.description:
Princess Vivi devises a plan to test the hearts of a gang of so-called rebels. They talk a good game, but will their bite measure up to their bark?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 100
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue their journey to Yuba, where a bittersweet reunion with a childhood friend awaits Princess Vivi.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 101
sub.description:
Fire Fist Ace is hired by two young boys to hunt down and capture a lethal bounty hunter known only as the Scorpion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 102
sub.description:
Chopper, Zoro, and Luffy get separate from the others. When the heat makes Luffy act even stranger than usual, his friends wonder if they joined the right pirate gang.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 103
sub.description:
The assassins of Baroque Works gather at Spider`s Cafe, and the Straw Hats arrive at Yuba only to find it buried in sand.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 104
sub.description:
Crocodile reveals himself to the Baroque Works assassins and discloses his dastardly plan for Alabasta. After departing Yuba, Luffy takes a stand that forces Vivi to rethink her mission.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 105
sub.description:
Vivi takes Luffy`s advice, and the Straw Hats head towards Rainbase for a confrontation with Crocodile. Karoo finally reaches the palace with Vivi`s warning for King Cobra.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 106
sub.description:
Luffy leads a daring - but foolish - raid on Crocodile`s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker - and more importantly, leaves Vivi unprotected.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 107
sub.description:
While the Straw Hats are stuck in the clink, King Cobra addresses the starving people of Nanohana. Will his unbelievable revelation drive his subjects past the brink of rebellion?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 108
sub.description:
A royal impostor has the rebel army hell-bent on bringing Cobra`s reign to a violent end. Meanwhile, Luffy and his mates find themselves in deep trouble and even deeper water.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 109
sub.description:
Sanji shows up in the nick of time to make the crocs cough up the key to Luffy`s freedom, but the ravenous reptiles spit up something else instead.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 110
sub.description:
Crocodile snatches Vivi off the back of a giant crab, but Luffy`s not having it. The rubber-man goes toe-to-toe with the sandman in a battle that will end in bloodshed.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 111
sub.description:
Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 112
sub.description:
Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 113
sub.description:
Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna`s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 114
sub.description:
Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy`s weakness.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 115
sub.description:
Chopper`s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 116
sub.description:
Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; and Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 117
sub.description:
Things don`t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami`s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 118
sub.description:
Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact`s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 119
sub.description:
Zoro hopes to attain a new level of strength when he fights a foe with a body made of blades. The Straw Hat sword-slinger is determined to become a man who can cut steel - or die trying.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 120
sub.description:
Koza - the leader of the rebel army - finally discovers the evil mastermind behind Alabasta`s drought, but is he too late to prevent further bloodshed?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 121
sub.description:
When Koza is mysteriously shot, the rebellion is reborn, but Vivi`s cries for a cease fire fall on deaf ears until a long-overdue hero swoops to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 122
sub.description:
Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won`t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 123
sub.description:
While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country`s greatest secret.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 124
sub.description:
With the walls crumbling down around them, Crocodile attacks Luffy with a poisoned pirate hook. Meanwhile, Vivi draws a bead on the bombers, but can she stop them in time?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 125
sub.description:
The Straw Hats team up to give Vivi one last shot at disarming the bomb that threatens to destroy her city. She succeeds in cutting the fuse, but Crocodile has a backup plan.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 126
sub.description:
Pell`s sacrifice spares his beloved city, but only an act of god can stop the rebellion. With Crocodile`s poison coursing through his body, Luffy musters a final attack against Alabasta`s oppressor.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 127
sub.description:
Crocodile is defeated, the rain has returned to Alabasta, and Vivi`s people are eager to rebuild their kingdom. As for the Straw Hats, they have a fleet of marines breathing down their necks.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 128
sub.description:
Now that the rebellion is over, Vivi must make an important decision about her future. The Straw Hats are ready to hoist the anchor, but an ambiguous villain has stolen the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 129
sub.description:
Mr. 2 is a man of many faces, but he finally shows his true colors when the marines attack the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, Vivi has a scheme up her sleeve, and it involves Igaram wearing a dress.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 130
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew watch Alabasta fade into the distance, but there`s no time for reminiscing. The marines are in hot pursuit, and there`s a stowaway aboard the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 131
sub.description:
Fresh off their adventure Alabasta, the Straw Hats discover an isolated island where they can restock their food supply. Chopper is left to guard the ship, but he and Nico spend the afternoon exploring instead!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 132
sub.description:
When a mail-order salesman gets lost at sea, Nami finds the paper she needs to start making maps. If the Straw Hat crew can somehow manage to survive a deadly cyclone, she might actually get some use out of it!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 133
sub.description:
Heavy fog leads to a close encounter of the culinary kind when Nico fishes a marine out of the drink. The aspiring chef is concerned about the quality of his curry, and Sanji is just the guy to refine his recipe!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 134
sub.description:
A break in the rain provides the perfect opportunity for Usopp to help a young girl fulfill her dream of launching the world`s largest firework.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 135
sub.description:
Money troubles force Zoro to tangle with Dick the Bandit and his treacherous gang of thugs. These gun-toting outlaws are terrorizing a peaceful village, and the Straw Hat swordsman aims to stop their reign of terror!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 136
sub.description:
A barrage of Marine cannon balls forces the Straw Hats to seek refuge on an uncharted island. Once ashore, the crew encounters a strange old man living amongst a herd of goats.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 137
sub.description:
Old man Zenny made a fortune lending money to scallywags, but he always dreamed of becoming a pirate himself. When the marines set out to trap the Straw Hats, the wily hermit may finally get his wish!

Zenny gets more than he bargained for when he embarks on his maiden pirate voyage. The Straw Hats may have made a friend for life, but what are they gonna do about those pesky marines?

The Straw Hats stop for supplies at a harbor town plagued by a mayor who taxes anything and everything. Over lunch, Luffy and Nico befriend a kooky scientist who`s obsessed with the Rainbow Mist.

Luffy, Usopp, Nico, and Zoro get trapped in the Rainbow Mist along with Henzo. The aging scientist is looking for answers, the Straw Hats want treasure, and the ghosts who haunt the mist want them all to leave!

sub.description:
Nami enters the mist on a mission to save her mates - and maybe hunt for treasure while she`s at it. The local mayor wants her dead, but the Straw Hats are being protected by a mysterious marine.

sub.title: Episode 143
sub.description:
The showdown with Mayor Wetton builds towards an explosive finale as the Straw Hats scramble to escape the Rainbow Mist - or be trapped inside forever.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.description:
The Straw Hats are nearly crushed by the falling wreckage of a ship that`s over 200 years old. Could rumors of a floating island in the sky be true? Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji go scuba diving to find out!

sub.description:
Still searching for a route to the island in the sky, the Straw Hats chart a course for Jaya. Meanwhile, Fire-Fist Ace crashes a party aboard a vessel helmed by Buggy the Pirate!

sub.description:
The Straw Hats drop anchor at a town overrun by scallywags, so Nami makes the boys swear to stay out of trouble. But when the Bellamy Pirates come looking for a fight, Luffy may have to break his promise!

sub.description:
Nico`s handy work unearths a solitary dreamer who may know the way to Sky Island. All Luffy and his crew have to do is survive the sonic onslaught of simian salvagers seeking to sink the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.description:
Luffy and his mates reach the home of Mont Blanc Cricket: the man with the key to reaching Sky Island. There`s just one tiny problem - he comes from a long line of legendary liars.

sub.description:
Montblanc Cricket agrees to help the Straw Hats reach Sky Island, but first they must venture deep into the darkest depths of a spider-infested forest to capture a mysterious bird with a keen sense of direction.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 150
sub.description:
While the Straw Hats battle creepy-crawly forest creatures on their quest to capture a South Bird, Mont Blanc and his monkey minions are brutally attacked by the Bellamy Pirates!

sub.description:
Luffy turned the other cheek during his first encounter with Bellamy, but now he`s out to settle the score for old man Mont Blanc. Meanwhile, a fearsome pirate crew takes aim at the Straw Hats, eager to earn a bad reputation!

Thanks to some modifications to the Going Merry, the Straw Hats are on their way to that island in the sky! But with the Blackbeard Pirates in hot pursuit, navigating the vertical currents will be anything but easy.

Nami`s eagerness to explore the forbidden realm of Upper Yard brings her face to face with the wrath of god, and the Straw Hats incur Heaven`s Judgment for failing to pay their immigration fees!

sub.description:

sub.description:

sub.description:

Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel. But it`s not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 392
sub.description:
Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line`s most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy`s crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 393
sub.description:
A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 394
sub.description:
Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 395
sub.description:
With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 396
sub.description:
Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed celestial dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 397
sub.description:
Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a celestial dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 398
sub.description:
They saved Cami from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass Captain Kid and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 399
sub.description:
The Straw Hats join forces with Kid’s crew and Trafalgar’s mates to make short work of the marines, but they’re in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 400
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh’s house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger’s ship.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 401
sub.description:
Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 402
sub.description:
A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a warlord lookalike.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 403
sub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far more deadly foe comes looking for a fight.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 404
sub.description:
Zoro’s barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 405
sub.description:
One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 406
sub.description:
Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a warlord of the sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 407
sub.description:
Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 408
sub.description:
Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man’s amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 409
sub.description:
An army of scantily-clad Amazonian warriors want to investigate Luffy’s family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 410
sub.description:
The Amazonians chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she’s about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 411
sub.description:
Luffy’s search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a “drop-in” on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 412
sub.description:
Boa Hancock makes Luffy fighting mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging captain Straw Hat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 413
sub.description:
The Snake Princess pits Luffy’s Gum Gum abilities against the incredible Haki Power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 414
sub.description:
Luffy kicks his attack mode into second gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle’s climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 415
sub.description:
News of Luffy’s run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 416
sub.description:
Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty amazons eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 417
sub.description:
Boa Hancock`s illness threatens to sabotage Luffy`s rescue mission; however, the Snake Princess just can`t say "no" to the rubberman, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 418
sub.description:
While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 419
sub.description:
Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji`s refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of "girlish hearts".
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 420
sub.description:
Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 421
sub.description:
Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 422
sub.description:
Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace`s execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 423
sub.description:
Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who`s going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There`s no love lost between Buggy the Clown and the Straw Hat captain, but they`d better work together if they want to survive.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 424
sub.description:
Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down`s Crimson Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 425
sub.description:
Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren`t careful in Impel Down`s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison`s putrid warden!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 426
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 427
sub.description:
The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 428
sub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 429
sub.description:
Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 430
sub.description:
Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 431
sub.description:
While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 432
sub.description:
Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 433
sub.description:
Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn`t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they`ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 434
sub.description:
Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 435
sub.description:
Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who`s deadly to the touch?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 436
sub.description:
Luffy`s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 437
sub.description:
Luffy is at the end of the line - the only thing that can save him now is true friendship. But in a place like Impel Down can true friendship be found?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 438
sub.description:
No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 439
sub.description:
Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan`s agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 440
sub.description:
Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy`s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 441
sub.description:
Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he`s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission - until he learns of Luffy`s lineage!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 442
sub.description:
The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan`s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 443
sub.description:
Luffy`s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 444
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard`s arrival leads to the release of the prison`s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 445
sub.description:
Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 446
sub.description:
Luffy`s bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say - heads will roll!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 447
sub.description:
Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard`s vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 448
sub.description:
Ace is to be executed in a matter of hours, and Magellan`s toxic breath is singeing the back of Luffy`s neck. Ivan uses a devastating Death Wink to buy some time, but the warden`s Poison Hydra may be more than he can handle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 449
sub.description:
Luffy dons a suit of waxy armor in preparation for his rematch with Warden Magellan. Outside the prison walls, Jimbei turns a door into a boat, so Crocodile and Buggy can commandeer an escape vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 450
sub.description:
Magellan takes his toxic attack to the next level by unleashing the hideous and deadly Venom Demon! If Jimbei and Crocodile don`t return with a rescue ship soon, Luffy won`t survive long enough to save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 451
sub.description:
Luffy and his merry band of escapees are safely onboard the rescue ship, but they`re not out hot water just yet. A fleet of marines is bombarding them with cannon balls, and an impenetrable gate looms on the horizon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 452
sub.description:
Luffy and Ivan mourn the loss of Bon Clay, and Captain Buggy`s reputation gets a boost when a phone call from the Marines reveals the secrets of his past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 453
sub.description:
While Luffy continues his rescue mission, Nami learns a lesson about how to turn rain into cash, and Franky wakes up in a freezing forest full of ferocious cyborg animals!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 454
sub.description:
Sanji tries to fight his way off a most peculiar island, but his frilly battle costume threatens to awaken his inner maiden. Elsewhere, Chopper tries to avoid being served in a hot pot!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 455
sub.description:
Nico Robin lends her many hands to an overmatched gang of revolutionaries in a frigid land of eternal suffering, and Usopp bulks up to avoid becoming a snack for a hungry, hungry island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 456
sub.description:
Zoro`s attempt to reunite with his friends leads him a massive tomb and a host of shadowy swordsmen. Elsewhere, Brook uses his status as Satan to get an eyeful of undergarments!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 457
sub.description:
While the marines prepare for Ace`s execution, Luffy looks back on all the good times he shared with his brother, and Jimbei reveals the shocking details of the day Fire Fist Ace went down in defeat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 458
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang continue on their way to Marineford, but once he arrives, the rubber-man must defeat both Navy Admirals and Warlords of the Sea before he can save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 459
sub.description:
Citizens and soldiers alike prepare for all-out war as Ace is led to the site of his execution. While the world watches, the true identity of the condemned man`s father is shockingly revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 460
sub.description:
Flashbacks reveal the agonizing sacrifice made by Ace`s mother in order save his life - and the secret behind his connection to Luffy. Back in the present, Whitebeard makes a unexpected entrance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 461
sub.description:
As a massive seaquake rocks Marineford, Ace recalls the ups and downs of his life as a pirate, including his first encounter with Whitebeard - and the unthinkable betrayal that led to his capture!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 462
sub.description:
Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 463
sub.description:
Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There`s only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 464
sub.description:
A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm`s reach of his friend when he`s intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 465
sub.description:
In the wake of Little Oars Junior`s tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace`s execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 466
sub.description:
Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man`s refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 467
sub.description:
Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 468
sub.description:
Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy`s own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 469
sub.description:
A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san`s Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 470
sub.description:
Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy`s onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren`t ready to give up the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 471
sub.description:
Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 472
sub.description:
Whitebeard is betrayed - and brutally stabbed - by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 473
sub.description:
Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy`s defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 474
sub.description:
With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 475
sub.description:
Crocodile`s unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 476
sub.description:
The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 477
sub.description:
While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a trouble youth spent seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 478
sub.description:
Luffy makes short work of face from his past, and Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner`s swords hovering above Ace`s head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 479
sub.description:
Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises up to derail the rescue mission at the last second!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 480
sub.description:
Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight - his own grandfather - in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won`t be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide back up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 481
sub.description:
Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 482
sub.description:
Despite Whitebeard`s order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 483
sub.description:
An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 484
sub.description:
Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace`s tragic death. Luffy - paralyzed by grief - must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 485
sub.description:
Whitebeard’s children watch in horror as the old man faces off the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never, ever runs away from a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 486
sub.description:
The world reacts to Whitebeard`s death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy and Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 487
sub.description:
While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy`s desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu`s fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 488
sub.description:
Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route, Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-hair marine changes the world with a scream!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 489
sub.description:
The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 490
sub.description:
The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard`s death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy`s friends fear that Ace`s death may be more than the rubber-man can handle - if he ever wakes up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 491
sub.description:
Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard, and Luffy`s nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 492
sub.description:
One Piece X Toriko Crossover
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 493
sub.description:
A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 494
sub.description:
The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 495
sub.description:
Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight - even when he`s outnumbered!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 496
sub.description:
When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend`s past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates, and hoist a toast to brotherhood!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 497
sub.description:
After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 498
sub.description:
Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that`s been stealing their food, Ace gets angry when his father`s identity is revealed, and Sabo`s parents hire pirates to track down their son!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 499
sub.description:
Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeating the big tiger - and becoming a good captian!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 500
sub.description:
The brothers are captured by a gang of pirates, and Sabo is handed over to his noble father, where the boy quickly discovers a sinister plot to destroy Gray Terminal forever!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 501
sub.description:
While flames spread across Gray Terminal, Sabo makes a desperate attempt to escape the trappings of his noble birth and save his brothers. Meanwhile, Luffy and Ace must fight to avoid an untimely end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 502
sub.description:
Luffy is spared from a fiery death by an unlikely rescuer, but Ace refuses to leave Gray Terminal until he settles the score with Bluejam. Meanwhile, Sabo makes waves with a last ditch escape attempt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 503
sub.description:
Luffy and Ace receive troubling reports of a Celestial attack on Sabo`s ship. Ace is eager to seek out the responsible parties and extract revenge, but a letter from his absent brother tempers his eagerness to fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 504
sub.description:
In the wake of Sabo`s death, Luffy and Ace grow stronger than ever by continuing their daily routine of nonstop fighting. As the years pass, each brother prepares to set sail in search of future adventures!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 505
sub.description:
Garp takes a beating from a heartbroken mountain bandit, and a big, blue friend helps Luffy drown his despair in the newfound desire to reunite with his mates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 506
sub.description:
One by one, the Straw Hats are crushed to learn the tragic fate of Fire Fist Ace. Despite their own unique problems, the crew members` thoughts immediately turn to their crestfallen captain.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 507
sub.description:
Luffy is determined to reassemble his scattered crew, but a powerful old friend forces him to rethink his plans. Meanwhile, Usopp fights to escape an island that wants to have him for lunch!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 508
sub.description:
Desperate to reach Luffy, Nami risks her life to escape from an island of weather wizards. Meanwhile, Franky rides a carbonation high through the ice and snow in search of a seaworthy vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 509
sub.description:
Zoro`s escape attempt is thwarted by a gang of sword-slinging baboon bullies, and Brook uses music to end a feud between irate islanders with unequal arms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 636
sub.description:
Bartolomeo and Bellamy take center stage in the latest round of the battle royal, but a slugger with a serious punch threatens to steal their thunder. Meanwhile, Luffy is targeted by an angry behemoth!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 637
sub.description:
An old enemy of Garp`s reveals Luffy`s true identity, landing the Straw Hat captain in hot water with one of his fellow competitors. Meanwhile, the battle in Block B gets supremely brutal!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 638
sub.description:
Franky`s new robot friend promises to reveal the tragic secrets of Dressrosa, and a regal brawler prepares to throw a powerful punch that could destroy the entire colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 639
sub.description:
While Law, Robin, Usopp, and Caesar attempt to survive a Fighting Fish attack, Sanji learns the heartbreaking truth about the beautiful woman who stole his heart!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 640
sub.description:
Luffy`s turn to fight in the epic colosseum battle draws near, Zoro has an interesting encounter with a surprisingly strong fairy, and the thoughts in Sanji`s head shock his lady captor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 641
sub.description:
Sanji learns some disturbing news that could mean trouble for his friends, Luffy prepares for a fight, and Robin is captured by a village full of little people!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 642
sub.description:
Despite Sanji`s attempt to warn him, Law finds his life in danger after being ambushed by Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Luffy is unable to hide his true identity once the fists start flying!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 643
sub.description:
After his plan falls apart, Law must fight for his life against two powerful opponents. Elsewhere, Sanji bids a touching goodbye to his special lady friend, and Luffy tangles with Brutal Bull!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 644
sub.description:
Nami, Chopper, and Brook are grotesquely transformed by a hideous woman who fancies herself an artist. Back at the colosseum, Luffy gets serious when his new friend falls victim to a giant attack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 645
sub.description:
Zoro and his fairy friend argue over directions, Trafalgar Law finds himself outnumbered in his battle with Doflamingo, and Luffy`s latest opponent packs an explosive punch!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 646
sub.description:
While Nami, Chopper, and Brook attempt to take back the Sunny, Luffy and the monstrous mauler Don Chinjao take their brutal grudge match to a legendary level!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 647
sub.description:
Luffy`s battle with Don Chinjao heats up, Franky learns the tragic truth behind Dressrosa`s mysterious toy population, and Robin and Usopp prepare to join their little friends in battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 648
sub.description:
Luffy continues his battle with Don Chinjao, Franky and Zoro are reunited in the land of the little people, and Law is wounded in a revealing, face-to-face showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 649
sub.description:
A flashback reveals the story of how Garp changed Chinjao`s world forever. Back in the present, Luffy and his opponent trade ferocious blows that literally rock the colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 650
sub.description:
During a break between battles, Luffy is attacked by an angry rival, but a beautiful gladiator with mysterious motives offers him food - and a place to rest.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 651
sub.description:
In the moments before battle, the beautiful gladiator Rebecca flashes back to the tragic events of her childhood and the toy soldier who became her constant companion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 652
sub.description:
The bloodthirsty crowd hurls insults at Rebecca as the battle of Block D begins. On the other side of the island, Law finds himself on the losing end of his battle with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 653
sub.description:
Brook`s trickery springs the Straw Hats from their artistic prison, but their failure to cuff the culprit means they`ll need help from a cola-powered cannon to emerge victorious!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 654
sub.description:
Cavendish wins over the female fans during the Block D battle, Luffy keeps an eye on Rebecca, and Sanji heads toward a heated collision with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 655
sub.description:
Sanji`s battle with Doflamingo is interrupted by Law`s sudden arrival, and Rebecca continues her impressive showing in the battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 656
sub.description:
Law begins a deadly, face-to-face battle with Doflamingo, Zoro enlists the aid of a star struck gladiator, and Rebecca continues to impresses Luffy with her unique fighting style!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 657
sub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 658
sub.description:
Rebecca`s battle continues, a madman turns a gladiator into a play thing, and the brave little toy soldier reveals his painful past – and the tragic truth behind King Riku`s fall from power!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 659
sub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 660
sub.description:
Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 661
sub.description:
Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 662
sub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 663
sub.description:
Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 664
sub.description:
Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 665
sub.description:
Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 666
sub.description:
Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 667
sub.description:
Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 668
sub.description:
Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 669
sub.description:
Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 670
sub.description:
Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 671
sub.description:
Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 672
sub.description:
The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier’s stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 673
sub.description:
Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 674
sub.description:
With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 675
sub.description:
The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 676
sub.description:
In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 677
sub.description:
Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 678
sub.description:
Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo’s clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 679
sub.description:
Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 680
sub.description:
The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 681
sub.description:
As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 682
sub.description:
Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 683
sub.description:
Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 684
sub.description:
With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 685
sub.description:
Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica’s giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 686
sub.description:
Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 687
sub.description:
Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 688
sub.description:
Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 689
sub.description:
Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 690
sub.description:
The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 691
sub.description:
Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 692
sub.description:
The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 693
sub.description:
Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 694
sub.description:
Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 695
sub.description:
Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 696
sub.description:
