Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 961
sub.description:
When the angry mountain god, the giant boar, almost kills Kin’emon, Oden steps in. Kin’emon is impressed when he sees Oden’s strength and pledges his life to serve him. Disavowed by his father, Oden decides to go on a journey around the country and gathers more followers along the way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 962
sub.description:
Oden transforms the wild land of Kuri into a habitable region and is made Daimyo over it. Then he meets Kawamatsu the Kappa and the two Minks, Dogstorm and Cat Viper, who become his followers like the others. Kin’emon and the other vassals are scolded by Yasuie when they try to steal money from him, and they begin reforming themselves for their lord Oden.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 963
sub.description:
Whitebeard and his crew dock at one of the ports in the Land of Wano with their broken ship and the news excites Oden. He runs to the port and asks Whitebeard to let him get on board the ship but the request is rejected. When the ship`s repairs are complete, Whitebeard tries to sneak out of the country, but he finds Oden tagging along.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 964
sub.description:
Oden’s journey finally begins. He is in awe of all the things that he has never seen before. And for the first time in his life, he becomes a wanted person and makes the headlines which catches the eye of a high-profile figure. Meanwhile he becomes romantically involved with Toki and they have a child together.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 965
sub.description:
In the Land of Wano, the Shogun Sukiyaki falls critically ill and names Orochi proxy Shogun until Oden returns in case he dies. Meanwhile, Whitebeard’s ship carrying Oden docks at some island overseas, unaware that Gold Roger and his clan are fighting against the Navy on the other side of the island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 966
sub.description:
Roger is amazed when he finds out that Oden can read the script on the Ponegliff since he believes it will guide him to the last, undiscovered island where no man has ever been. Roger begs Whitebeard for permission to take Oden with him on a one-year journey. But Oden gives it some thought and speaks his mind as well!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 967
sub.description:
Singing out loud, the Roger Pirates continue on with their journey. They soar up to the island above the clouds and go down into the deep sea to get to the island at the sea bottom. Oden deciphers the Ponegliffs on those islands for Roger who believes those inscriptions will tell them the location of the last island on the Grand Line.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 968
sub.description:
Oden and the Roger Pirates head for the Land of Wano to obtain a copy of the Road Ponegliff. Oden sees Kin’emon and the others for the first time in years, but he immediately returns to the sea leaving his wife and children behind. Then, after stopping by at the Mokomo Dukedom and getting a copy of the last Road Ponegliff, the Roger Pirates finally make it to the last island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 969
sub.description:
After reaching Laugh Tale, Roger declares the disbanding of his pirate group and disembarks first. Oden gets dropped off at the Land of Wano and reunites with his family and retainers. Later, he hears that Orochi took over the country with the help of a strong pirate named Kaido after the Shogun Sukiyaki’s death and becomes enraged by stories of his tyrannical acts.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 970
sub.description:
Enraged by Orochi’s tyrannical acts, Oden raids his castle in the Flower Capital and points his sword at Orochi. However, hours later, people who were waiting for Oden to come out after defeating Orochi see the unexpected. Meanwhile, the King of the Pirates Roger’s execution and last words are printed in newspapers and spread across the world.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 971
sub.description:
Oden keeps dancing naked in the Flower Capital and losing all the trust of the people. One day, Orochi comes to Kuri and reveals his evil plan for the Land of Wano as well as his brutalities against the country’s mobster and Oden’s friend, Hyogoro and his wife. Despairing and in a rage, Oden finally decides to take down Orochi’s supporter, Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 972
sub.description:
Kaido comes to the mainland along with his troops to fight against Oden and the Akazaya samurai who were on their way to raid Kaido’s mansion. Even though Oden’s group are unprepared and outnumbered, they fight hard to save the future of the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 973
sub.description:
Oden and the Akazaya members are sentenced to death by boiling in a pot. Oden asks for a chance to survive which is accepted by Kaido. Then, Oden enters the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head. Shinobu watches from among the spectators and reveals what Oden had been doing to save the country, to the surprise of the citizens.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 974
sub.description:
As Oden continues trying to survive in the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head, people learn the truth from Shinobu and get shocked.
At the same time, Oden tells his retainers the importance of opening the borders of the Land of Wano. Time ticks down for Oden and his clan’s freedom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 975
sub.description:
As Kin’emon and the others run to Oden Castle to save Oden’s family, the castle is set on fire and Kaido attacks Toki and her children. Leaving Momonosuke to Kin’emon and Hiyori to Kawamatsu, Toki appears in front of the desperate people of the Land of Wano and gives a prophecy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 976
sub.description:
After 20 years since Oden Castle burned down, Oden’s surviving retainers are working hard separately at their own missions, believing in Toki’s prophecy. The day of the Fire Festival has finally come and the whole army is now getting ready to head for Onigashima to raid Kaido!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 977
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and thousands of allies who were supposed to be there are nowhere to be found, but Kin’emon and the others decide to set sail to the stormy sea in a small boat. Kaido’s army that appears out of nowhere and a betrayal drive the Akazaya members into a corner.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 978
sub.description:
Luffy, Law, and Kid join the Akazaya samurai and begin to fight Kaido’s army. The three rivals from the Worst Generation compete with each other as they attack the enemy fleet with their ultimate skills. When it seems like they gain upper hand in the battle, another strong enemy appears to help Kaido’s army.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 979
sub.description:
The Akazaya members are surprised by help from their old mate and Kin’emon notices he made a big mistake which has luckily saved all his allies. As their battle against Kaido’s army heats up, the cornered Kanjuro makes a stunning move.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 980
sub.description:
Swept away by Kanjuro, Momonosuke remembers his father, tries to rise above his fear, and speak to his allies. Luffy and the others start heading for Onigashima, but Kaido’s army gets in their way again with a formidable weapon. However, a surprising figure comes to help the cornered Straw Hats.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 981
sub.description:
Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat crew are excited to see Jimbei again and welcome him as a new member. Meanwhile, Law and the Akazaya members strategize on how to enter Onigashima and attack Kaido. As the Straw Hats approach the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima, they are attacked out of the blue.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 982
sub.description:
To Law and the others’ surprise, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats attack the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima. Meanwhile, Kaido and Orochi are having a big banquet on the island where Kaido’s formidable subordinates are also called in.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 983
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and the samurai warriors finally reach Onigashima! Before they set out for the castle as they planned, the samurai warriors use surprising but determined tactics to cut off their retreat which leave the Straw Hats in shock.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 984
sub.description:
Eustass Kid and his clan start heading for Kaido`s castle head on waving Luffy off. Luffy and Zoro go after them to stop them from causing trouble, but they happen to step into Kaido’s banquet. Meanwhile, Kanjuro loses his way to Kaido in underground passages with Momonosuke who he kidnapped in tow.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 985
sub.description:
Luffy and Zoro each witness Kaido’s subordinates waste food at the banquet and make fun of the poor people in the Land of Wano. Thinking of Otama, a small girl who liked red-bean soup so much, both Luffy and Zoro become infuriated and create turmoil.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 986
sub.description:
After making a scene at the Golden Festival, Luffy and Zoro try to get away, but Queen announces his subordinates that anyone who catches them will be rewarded with a position in the Tobi Roppo. Scratchmen Apoo stands Luffy and Zoro’s way and with his ability to use music as a weapon, he launches unpredictable attacks which corner Luffy and Zoro.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 987
sub.description:
Haccha, a supergiant Number, joins in and the pursuit of Luffy and the others becomes even more intense. Meanwhile, Kin’emon changes his strategy and his group tries to infiltrate the castle from its side, but there is an unexpected change of the floor plan which coincidentally makes Sanji excited.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 988
sub.description:
Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and all the others are trying to infiltrate Kaido’s castle from all sides. Meanwhile, Big Mom’s children are climbing up the waterfall towards Onigashima again, but this time, Marco the Phoenix appears from nowhere and stands in their way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 989
sub.description:
The furious Big Mom chases Brachio Tank driven by Chopper and Usopp, but they bravely fight back! Meanwhile, Kanjuro takes the battered and bruised Momonosuke to Kaido and Orochi, then breaks the news to them about Oden’s retainers who were thought to be dead.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 990
sub.description:
Luffy runs into Ulti and Page One, members of the Tobi Roppo from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Hearing that he aims to become the King of the Pirates, the brother and sister duo become infuriated and turn themselves into massive beasts. When Luffy is driven into a corner, someone wearing a demon mask appears and whisks him away.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 991
sub.description:
Evading Ulti and Page One, strong members of the Tobi Roppo, Luffy tries to find out what Kaido’s son Yamato’s motive is. However, the two get in a fight. Taking Luffy’s punishing attacks, Yamato remembers someone he fought against in the past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 992
sub.description:
The Akazaya members who were on board Law’s Polar Tang finally reach Onigashima and see someone who they didn’t expect. Kaido’s son Yamato starts telling his story to Luffy, shares his passion, and reveals what’s behind his mask!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 993
sub.description:
At the back entrance of Onigashima, the Akazaya members try to get inside the gate, but they’re blocked by their former colleague Kanjuro. Meanwhile, as Kaido’s son Yamato shows Luffy the handcuffs that have restricted his freedom for years, they hear Kaido making a speech on his grand plan.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 994
sub.description:
Kaido’s plan to obtain the great treasure infuriates Orochi, but his unexpected violent move silences everyone. Meanwhile at the back entrance of Onigashima, Kikunojo squares off against Kanjuro and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 995
sub.description:
The Akazaya members start charging towards Kaido from the back of Onigashima. Meanwhile, at the Performance Floor, Kaido closes in on Momonosuke shivering in terror and asks him the ultimate question which will determine his fate.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 996
sub.description:
The Akazaya members deliver a crushing blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to back them up, but Ulti stands in their way and Big Mom spots Luffy. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot free themselves from their enemies and move on to take back Zeus!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 997
sub.description:
The Animal Kingdom Pirates gasp with surprise to see thousands of samurai warriors coming into the castle. In his dragon form, Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazaya members under the moon. However, the Akazaya members have secret weapons to use against him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 998
sub.description:
Shinobu tries to rescue the weakened Momonosuke but is found by King and attacked. On the other hand, Nami takes back Zeus from Big Mom and runs away but loses him again and gets chased by Zeus who is ordered to kill to her by Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 999
sub.description:
Franky faces Big Mom with the help of Robin and Jimbei, but the Numbers come interrupting their battle. One of them holds Brachio Tank with Usopp and Chopper inside in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato, the self-proclaimed Oden, finally meets his son Momonosuke.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1000
sub.description:
As the Minks struggle with a poor hand against the Gifters, Kin’emon tries to assist them, but Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop him and start fighting for the other Minks! Meanwhile, Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help Kin’emon and the others, but Queen and King get in their way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1001
sub.description:
Who’s-Who invites Drake and Hawkins to a plot to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down. As Luffy charges towards them, someone unexpected comes in to help.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1002
sub.description:
Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Usopp’s practical joke pushes Nami into confronting Ulti, who is infuriated since her brother got attacked.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1003
sub.description:
Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into ogre-like monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner. However, Kaido stands up for his subordinate.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1004
sub.description:
While Luffy is hurrying to the rooftop and Yamato is trying to catch up to Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazaya members finally face off against Kaido. Hearing Kaido jeering at them for being weak, the samurai retainers attack him relentlessly, remembering the day Oden told them to master his sword skill.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1005
sub.description:
Queen, the Lead Performer, blazes away at samurai on the Performance Floor with the special version of the Plague Rounds, which turns them into hideous ogres that corner Zoro and Drake. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji, who are on their way to the rooftop, run into another Headliner with a special ability.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1006
sub.description:
King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Shinobu tries to protect him, but they are cornered by one of the strong Lead Performers from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen’s Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1007
sub.description:
Yamato fights Sasaki and the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division to protect Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game which involves the antibody for the virus.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1008
sub.description:
Ulti and Page One of the Tobi Roppo chase Nami and Usopp, after being infuriated by their attack as well as Luffy’s declaration of becoming the King of the Pirates. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1009
sub.description:
Carrot and Wanda step in to help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights a fierce battle against the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division led by Sasaki, while protecting Shinobu and Momonosuke.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1010
sub.description:
Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei, and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop where the Akazaya members’ tough battle against Kaido rages on.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1011
sub.description:
Sanji hears a woman’s scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it’s a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1012
sub.description:
While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1013
sub.description:
Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once confronted a man, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido’s head. His name was Ace. The two of them engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1014
sub.description:
The formidable Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates stand in Zoro’s way as he tries to get to the rooftop. Marco sees his late comrade in Zoro’s determination and tries to pave the way for him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1015
sub.description:
Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1016
sub.description:
Luffy’s strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong ones he’s ever met. On the other hand, Luffy, Law, and Kid keep quarreling amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria in what he calls “heaven.”
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1017
sub.description:
Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro, and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1018
sub.description:
Luffy pummels Kaido with his well-trained Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way and Kid and Killer also try to finish Kaido off.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1019
sub.description:
After watching the Straw Hats’ departure to Onigashima, Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she’s here on Onigashima, it’s time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1020
sub.description:
Sanji is captured and tortured by the merciless Black Maria. She names the terms of his release: to turn over one of his crewmates. He hesitates but has no other option. After much distress, he makes a move that surprises everyone.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1021
sub.description:
Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji along with Brook, and faces Black Maria, who is trying to keep Sanji as her pet. Meanwhile, Yamato, Momonosuke, and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy, and they find themselves on the run again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1022
sub.description:
Chopper works hard to make the cure for Ice Oni, even though he is turning into one himself. Meanwhile, the infected Boss Hyogoro the Flower regains his youth and fights fiercely to protect Chopper and the others.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1023
sub.description:
Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn’t just them who were devastated by Queen’s raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1024
sub.description:
The wounded Akazaya members are surprised to see Kozuki Oden alive. They were disappointed by their failure to take down Kaido, but now with their lord, they are filled with hope to face their sworn enemy again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1025
sub.description:
The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him. Meanwhile, on the rooftop, Kaido and Big Mom unleashes a combination attack on Luffy and the others.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1026
sub.description:
The returned Orochi clashes the Akazaya members who are trying to save Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others are all covered in bruises, but they unite their strength and launch an attack.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1027
sub.description:
Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1028
sub.description:
Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1029
sub.description:
A young Luffy who has been dreaming about getting out of Windmill Village one day to accomplish something great meets a young girl named Uta who came along with Shanks and the Red-Hair Pirates calling herself the musician of the pirate group. 
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1030
sub.description:
Luffy and Uta run across Windmill Village, compete with each other, and share their dreams with each other. They also pledge to build a new genesis for everyone to live happily. However, one day, the unexpected happens. 
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1031
sub.description:
Luffy and Kaido who have both infused themselves with the Color of the Supreme King clash! Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are running from Page One to get to the Performance Floor, but they bump into another tough enemy, Big Mom.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1032
sub.description:
Kin’emon and the Akazaya members are rushing to help Momonosuke and everyone else while Yamato leaves Momonosuke and Shinobu in a hide-out to lure away their enemies. At the same time, Ulti tries to avenge her brother against Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1033
sub.description:
Sanji is forced to run with Zoro on his shoulder. Meanwhile, Nami bravely stands up against Ulti and Big Mom. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido finally comes to an end.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1034
sub.description:
Luffy is pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in a fight between Big Mom and Nami’s group and stands up for the one who he wants to save. On the Performance Floor, Chopper is in a fierce battle against Queen.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1035
sub.description:
While the Straw Hats and their allies are all having a hard time, they are shocked by the news that Luffy lost to Kaido. At the same time, Kanjuro closes in on Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1036
sub.description:
Like all the other samurai, Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy’s loss and Queen doesn’t miss the chance to finish him off! Meanwhile, Kin’emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke and that motivates Momonosuke to rise up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1037
sub.description:
Momonosuke and Shinobu face Kaido while Kid and Law challenge Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami, heading towards the stage on the Performance Floor along with Usopp and Tama, hears a strange voice.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1038
sub.description:
Nami strikes a thunder blast to clear the way to the stage on the Performance Floor. However, the elite corps of the Gifters shows up to crush their inferior opponents. Upset but unbroken, Otama stands up to give a command!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1039
sub.description:
Hearing Otama’s command, the Gifters side with the samurai and upset the Tobi Roppo and others! Chopper starts to take care of Zoro while suffering from the side effect of the enhanced Rumble Ball. Meanwhile, Jimbei gets stunned by Who’s-Who’s story.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1040
sub.description:
Who’s-Who expresses fierce resentment toward Luffy and Jimbei fights back out of his loyalty to Luffy. As Who’s-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men and that sparks Jimbei’s outrage.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1041
sub.description:
To cut ties with Kaido, Yamato unleashes his true power. Meanwhile, Queen repeatedly attacks Sanji with his power as a cyborg, and Sasaki in his Man-Beast Form launches tricky attacks on Franky and drives him into a corner.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1042
sub.description:
Kaido tries to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of the Land of Wano and rule the country with the special power he obtained by accident. Meanwhile, Saul, Professor Clover, and Robin’s mother Olvia suddenly appear in front of her.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1043
sub.description:
In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1044
sub.description:
Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her, and she as Demon Child shows what she is really capable of.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1045
sub.description:
Killer is shocked to find out who Hawkins’ straw doll he slashed represents. Meanwhile, Sanji who is in a hard battle against Queen and King sees enemy brutes going after the injured Zoro, and no one else is there to save him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1046
sub.description:
Zoro gets back on his feet and along with Sanji, confronts King and Queen, the Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Watching Zoro fight, Hyogoro and Kawamatsu remember someone from way back.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1047
sub.description:
Dogstorm confronts his sworn enemy who destroyed his country. Meanwhile, Cat Viper faces Perospero who is responsible for Pedro’s death. At Tokage Port, Momonosuke roars with his determined eyes.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1048
sub.description:
The battle between Kaido and Yamato gets intense. Backed into a corner, Yamato remembers three great swordsmen who he met when he was a child. Their stunning choice for the future of the Land of Wano encourages Yamato.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1049
sub.description:
Luffy amps up the reluctant Momonosuke, who is afraid of heights, in his giant pink dragon form, to fly and take him to Onigashima in the sky. Meanwhile, Yamato, in a hard battle against Kaido, vows to survive until Luffy returns.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1050
sub.description:
Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1051
sub.description:
Asked to stop Onigashima by Luffy, Momonosuke once again gets cold feet, but this time, he has a reliable ally who can teach him how to fly. The clash between Luffy and Kaido shakes up the sky and enables Dogstorm and Cat Viper to exert all their strength.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1052
sub.description:
Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1053
sub.description:
Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1054
sub.description:
Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1055
sub.description:
Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1056
sub.description:
Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1057
sub.description:
Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1058
sub.description:
Kazenbo, the giant specter of fire symbolizing the burning wrath of the Kurozumi Clan, rampages through the castle creating panic among both the Animal Kingdom Pirates and the samurai. Orochi who is watching in excitement suddenly hears a sound that brings back memories.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1059
sub.description:
Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1060
sub.description:
Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1061
sub.description:
Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1062
sub.description:
Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1063
sub.description:
Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1064
sub.description:
In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1065
sub.description:
With the ongoing battles in various parts of Onigashima, everyone is reaching their limits. In the face of Big Mom, Law and Kid are exhausted and deeply wounded. Mocking them, Big Mom tries to head for the rooftop.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1066
sub.description:
Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1067
sub.description:
Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1068
sub.description:
Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1069
sub.description:
On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1070
sub.description:
The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. Kaido comes down and tells everyone that Luffy has been defeated and the Land of Wano is finished. Momonosuke and Yamato argue over whether they should still continue fighting.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1071
sub.description:
As Luffy’s heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1072
sub.description:
Bouncing on the ground and becoming a giant, Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power while Kaido is bewildered and can’t make sense of it. Meanwhile, Kid, Law, and Luffy’s other allies continue the fight down below against flames and enemies alike, waiting for Luffy to emerge victorious.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1073
sub.description:
Now the whole Onigashima is ablaze. Chopper reunites with Nami while Sanji and the others are each trying to escape from the flames. However, Raizo who harbors a great regret from his past stands up to the fire with the help of Jimbei.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1074
sub.description:
Momonosuke struggles to create Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima which is in free fall. In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is ending with people flying their Sky Boats in the air. To fulfill the promise to free the Land of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1075
sub.description:
When Oden died 20 years ago, Orochi took over the Land of Wano. People were separated from their loved ones, forced into labor, and starved. Now they pray that Kaido will vanish as Luffy’s battle against him reaches a climax.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1076
sub.description:
Kaido remembers how he was treated unfairly in the past and how he believes the world should be. While his friends struggle to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to picture his ideal world as he throws a destructive punch.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1077
sub.description:
The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1078
sub.description:
The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1079
sub.description:
The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1080
sub.description:
The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him. The reason behind his action surprises Luffy
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1081
sub.description:
As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1082
sub.description:
Navy Admiral Ryokugyu keeps up a savage assault against the Akazaya samurai who are still recovering from the last battle. Momonosuke tries to defend the Land of Wano with all his might, but he gets driven into a corner.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1083
sub.description:
Momonosuke and Hiyori are happy to see their grandfather who was supposed to be dead and the Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about Pluton the Ancient Weapon. Meanwhile, Momonosuke is kept busy in his role as the new Shogun.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1084
sub.description:
An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1085
sub.description:
Angered by Luffy`s attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1086
sub.description:
Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island,　Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1087
sub.description:
Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting　Hancock.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1088
sub.description:
The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1089
sub.description:
Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1090
sub.description:
Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1091
sub.description:
Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1092
sub.description:
While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1093
sub.description:
The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1094
sub.description:
The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they`ve never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1095
sub.description:
Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they’re in battle, some of Vegapunk’s Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1096
sub.description:
Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1097
sub.description:
Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1098
sub.description:
Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1099
sub.description:
CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1100
sub.description:
Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1101
sub.description:
Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1102
sub.description:
Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1103
sub.description:
CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1104
sub.description:
The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1105
sub.description:
Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats’ surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they’re stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1106
sub.description:
CP-0 takes control of the Fabriophase but gets attacked by an unknown force. Meanwhile, in the Labophase, the Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk’s Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1107
sub.description:
Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1108
sub.description:
The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1109
sub.description:
Lucci and Kaku from CP0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1110
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and CP0 relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the Seraphim keep getting back up. Then, Zoro notices that the Seraphim remind him of someone who he fought before. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk Stella might be.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1111
sub.description:
Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1112
sub.description:
Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. Shanks also prepares for the battle, but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1113
sub.description:
Held at the Pirate Island of Beehive, Koby gets a chance to be free but decides to become a decoy to liberate slaves on the island. Pirates from all over the island come after him because of the big bounty on his head.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1114
sub.description:
A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack on top of it to save his pupil Koby. Koby almost reaches the ship with Navy HQ Commander Hibari running by his side.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1115
sub.description:
Kuzan, a former Navy Admiral, stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp’s pupil but is now a member of the Blackbeard Pirates. What happened to him after he was defeated by Sakazuki is now revealed.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1116
sub.description:
Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1117
sub.description:
Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1118
sub.description:
In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1119
sub.description:
King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1120
sub.description:
Vivi tries to escape the Holy Land Mary Geoise with Wapol while the injured Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra’s message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1121
sub.description:
At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 1122
sub.description:
Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 1
dub.description: Alvida pirates plunder a ship only to find a barrel containing a strange boy names Luffy who is on a quest to find the legendary One Piece and become the King of Pirates.

dub.title: Episode 2
dub.description: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

dub.title: Episode 3
dub.description: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.

dub.title: Episode 4
dub.description: Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.

dub.title: Episode 5
dub.description: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she’s perfect for Luffy’s new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

dub.title: Episode 6
dub.description: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy’s pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.

dub.title: Episode 7
dub.description: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy's pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.

dub.title: Episode 8
dub.description: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.

dub.title: Episode 9
dub.description: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates' efforts to save her with a ship to call their own - the Going Merry!

dub.title: Episode 10
dub.description: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.

dub.title: Episode 11
dub.description: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world's greatest swordsman - but tragedy intervened.

dub.title: Episode 12
dub.description: The Straw Hats need a cook among their crew, so they head to a nearby restaurant and meet a passionate Sous Chef named Sanji.

dub.title: Episode 13
dub.description: Luffy witnesses the fighting prowess and compassionate nature of the Sous Chef Sanji. The good news: The Going Merry's found a cook! The bad news: He has no intention of joining the crew!

dub.title: Episode 14
dub.description: The staff and patrons of the Baratie panic when Don Krieg arrives! The starving pirate begs for nourishment, only to find himself denied. Unable to see a wretch starve, Sanji steps in once again.

dub.title: Episode 15
dub.description: Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!

dub.title: Episode 16
dub.description: The Going Merry's been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action's not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!

dub.title: Episode 17
dub.description: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg's pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren't looking too good!

dub.title: Episode 18
dub.description: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

dub.title: Episode 19
dub.description: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

dub.title: Episode 20
dub.description: The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.

dub.title: Episode 21
dub.description: The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent's weaponry.

dub.title: Episode 22
dub.description: With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.

dub.title: Episode 23
dub.description:
Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 24
dub.description:
The Going Merry`s been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action`s not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 25
dub.description:
The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg`s pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren`t looking too good!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 26
dub.description:
Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 27
dub.description:
As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 28
dub.description:
The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 29
dub.description:
The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent`s weaponry.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 30
dub.description:
With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 31
dub.description:
With their culinary concerns in good hands, the Straw Hats set off in search of Nami - who`s on a collision course with a deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 32
dub.description:
Zoro is captured by Fishman Arlong and learns a shocking secret about Nami. Unable to believe his ears, he puts the navigator to the ultimate test.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 33
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew make their way towards Arlong Park and a showdown with its fishy proprietor. Along the way, they discover a treasure map that raises more questions about Nami.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 34
dub.description:
A fierce argument over where Nami`s loyalties lie divides the Straw Hat Pirates and only one thing`s for sure - no one is willing to risk their life for a traitor.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 35
dub.description:
Nami`s adopted sister, Nojiko arrives to fill in some details about the skilled mapmaker`s younger days.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 36
dub.description:
Nojiko continues the story of Nami`s younger days. Back in the present, Nami gets agonizingly close to a long time goal, but betrayal looms on the horizon.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 37
dub.description:
Nezumi comes to confiscate Nami`s treasure, but who`s he working for? More importantly, who`s Nami working for, and what`s she gonna do with her booty?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 38
dub.description:
The Straw Hats` faith in Nami is restored, and now it`s time for a battle royal! Luffy and the gang are determined to make Arlong pay for mistreating their friend.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 39
dub.description:
The Straw Hats and Arlong`s fishmen are locked in a swashbuckling slugfest, but things take a bad turn when Luffy gets trapped beneath the waves.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 40
dub.description:
While his friends work to free the captain of the Straw Hats, cowardly Usopp finds himself in a position to shed his yellow streak and make his father proud.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 41
dub.description:
Nami must decide between letting Arlong maintain his hold over her, or joining the Straw Hats and leading the oppressed villagers against the tyrant fishman.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 42
dub.description:
Arlong better watch his back-fins, because Captain Luffy knows about all the horrible things he did to Nami - and it makes his blood boil?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 43
dub.description:
Something about Nami`s former prison gives Luffy an added burst of strength. He`s so moved by her terrible past that he vows to destroy all of Arlong Park!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 44
dub.description:
After a grueling fight, Luffy defeats Arlong and succeeds in destroying his headquarters. The merry marauders enjoy the fruits of victory while Nami makes peace with her turbulent past.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 45
dub.description:
Finally, the day has arrived where Luffy`s face is on an authentic wanted poster! Now there are enemies in hot pursuit as the crew makes waves for Logue Town - final resting place of Gold Roger!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 46
dub.description:
Buggy gets marooned on an island inhabited by unusual creatures and tangles with the island`s caretaker, Gaimon. If he is to finally destroy Luffy, Buggy must cast his lot with a mysterious woman.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 47
dub.description:
The Buggy Pirates fight each other for the right to take their lost captain`s place. While they`re busy beating each other`s brains out, a cannibalistic tribe makes plans to have something special for dinner.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 48
dub.description:
The Straw Hats arrive at Logue Town, and each crewmember embarks upon a mission of a more personal nature. While his crew shops, Luffy goes in search of sacred ground.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 49
dub.description:
Luffy has a run-in with Captain Smoker, and his failure to keep a low profile helps Buggy draw a bead on him. Elsewhere, Zoro takes a chance that his skill can overcome a dangerous curse.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 50
dub.description:
Usopp finds an amazing pair of sharpshooter`s goggles, but they lead to a run in with Daddy the Parent - the greatest gunslinger ever! Now, the Straw Hat marksman is headed for the deadliest of all duels.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 51
dub.description:
A cooking competition with the fiery chef Carmen rekindles Sanji`s dreams of the legendary All Blue.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 52
dub.description:
Buggy and his mysterious female ally trap Luffy on the same platform where Gold Roger was executed. He is to be killed for his offenses against Buggy, but Zoro and Sanji attempt a daring rescue mission.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 53
dub.description:
As a storm batters Logue Town, Buggy, Alvida, and Captain Smoker close in on Luffy for a stirring final showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 54
dub.description:
The discovery of a small girl adrift in an abandoned life boat interrupts Luffy and his crew`s voyage to the Grand Line.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 55
dub.description:
After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament - stranded in the Calm Belt!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 56
dub.description:
The Straw Hats want to return Apis`s dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it`s time for another daring escape!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 57
dub.description:
Even for Nami, finding the dragon`s lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack - or at the bottom of the ocean.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 58
dub.description:
Nami discovers a map to the true location of the dragon`s nest, and Zorro puts his steel to the test against Eric the Whirlwind.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 59
dub.description:
The Straw Hats sail headfirst into Commodore Nelson and his Marine armada. While Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro dodge cannon balls, Eric the Whirlwind prepares a sneak attack!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 60
dub.description:
With their rescue mission taking on water, the Straw Hats get some surprising help from the great blue yonder.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 61
dub.description:
After unlocking the secrets of the dragon`s nest, Luffy does battle with Eric the Whirlwind to ensure the safety of the island. Don`t mess with the rubberman!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 62
dub.description:
The Straw Hat crew takes a wild ride up and down a mountain only to end up in the belly of a giant whale that`s on the lookout for pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 63
dub.description:
Luffy trades blows with Laboon the whale, and Nami is distressed to learn that navigating the Grand Line is no easy feat.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 64
dub.description:
A violent snow storm batters the crew of the Going Merry, but once the Straw Hats arrive at Whisky Peak, the locals invite them to a raucous celebration.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 65
dub.description:
There are bounty hunters on the prowl, and most of the Straw Hats are dead drunk. Only Zoro is still sober enough to hoist a sword.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 66
dub.description:
There`s a mysterious princess that needs protection from a nose-picking assassin, but Luffy and Zoro are too busy duking it out to worry about explosive boogers.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 67
dub.description:
The Straw Hats depart Whisky Peak on a mission to return the Princess of Alabasta to her kingdom while protecting her from an army of vicious assassins.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 68
dub.description:
While the crew heads for Little Garden with the princess, Luffy and Zorro`s old nemesis, Axe-Hand Morgan, escapes from a Marine prison ship.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 69
dub.description:
Colby and Helmeppo train day and night to prove they`re tough enough to be Marines. A violent showdown with Vice-Admiral Garp will determine if they`re worth their salt.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 70
dub.description:
Luffy`s gang is running low on supplies, so they stop at Little Garden to find something to eat. Unfortunately for them, it might end up the other way around.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 71
dub.description:
Not only are there dinosaurs running wild on the island of Little Garden, but the Straw Hats soon find themselves in the middle of a gargantuan grudge match.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 72
dub.description:
Usopp and Luffy are fascinated by the endless battle waged between Dorry and Broggy; however, fascination turns to outrage when Monkey catches a whiff of treachery.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 73
dub.description:
Luffy`s blood boils for revenge against the assassins who sabotaged Dorry and Broggy`s battle, but he`s currently trapped between a rock and a hard place.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 74
dub.description:
While Luffy struggles to free himself, his friends fall into the hands of Baroque Works. Though the odds are against them, the Straw Hats will never give up!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 75
dub.description:
Nami, Zorro, and the Princess are in danger of becoming exhibits in a fiendish artist`s collection, and only Luffy can save them. But he`s busy having a cup of tea.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 76
dub.description:
With his friends about to be permanently entombed in wax, Usopp is provided with the perfect opportunity to be brave and make his father proud.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 77
dub.description:
After narrowly avoiding death, Luffy`s crew and the Princess set sail for Alabasta, but something large and dangerous looms in their path.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 78
dub.description:
Nami comes down with a terrible fever and the Straw Hats don`t know what to do. Looks like the Grand Line might claim another victim.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 79
dub.description:
The Straw Hats continue their quest to find a doctor for Nami. Along the way, they deal with a ravenous invader and get a chilly reception from local islanders.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 80
dub.description:
Luffy and Sanji make a bold trek up a snow-covered mountain in search of a witch who might hold the key to curing Nami.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 81
dub.description:
Ferocious, giant, snow rabbits slow Luffy and Sanji`s progress up the mountain. Meanwhile, the former king Wapol returns to the town he abandoned.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 82
dub.description:
Nami hovers near death while Luffy and Sanji fend off the abominable rabbits. Back at the village, Dalton leads a revolt against the dastardly Wapol.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 83
dub.description:
An unlikely source acts as a roadblock to give Luffy some climbing room, and Zorro emerges from a snow bank cold, cranky, and ready to rumble!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 84
dub.description:
After a long journey up the mountain, Nami finally receives much-needed medical attention, but Sanji and Luffy are more interested in eating the doctor!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 85
dub.description:
Luffy recruits Tony Tony Chopper to join the Straw Hat crew as the ship`s doctor.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 86
dub.description:
Chopper`s first friend was a quack doctor who couldn`t cure a cold, but the old man still managed to teach the little reindeer how to care for people.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 87
dub.description:
Luffy unleashes the full force of his Gum Gum furry on Wapol, and Chopper is amazed by the rubberman`s fierce devotion to the pirate flag.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 88
dub.description:
When Wapol orders his goons to attack the Straw Hats, Chopper shows off a little something he calls the Rumble Ball!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 89
dub.description:
Wapol attacks Nami in her weakened condition, but Monkey D. Luffy is quick to step in and even the odds.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 90
dub.description:
After an explosive battle with Wapol, Luffy begins the tiring process of convincing Chopper to join his pirate gang.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 91
dub.description:
Chopper sets sail for Alabasta with his new friends, and Dalton thinks back to his first meeting with Princess Vivi.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 92
dub.description:
The Straw Hats rescue a man of many faces as they approach Alabasta. Sure, he`s good for a laugh, but they may regret pulling him out of the drink.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 93
dub.description:
The Straw Hats arrive in Alabasta with precious little time to stop the rebellion. Sanji and Chopper are sent to gather supplies for a dangerous trip across the desert.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 94
dub.description:
Captain Smoker has Luffy in his grasp until a fiery stranger creates a diversion, giving the Straw Hats a chance to make a break for it.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 95
dub.description:
Ace and Luffy`s happy reunion is crudely interrupted by the Billions of Baroque Works. They may be outnumbered, but these brothers are no ordinary pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 96
dub.description:
Before they can start their trek across the desert, Luffy and the Straw Hats are stopped at the shore by the cute - but formidable - Kung Fu Dugongs.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 97
dub.description:
Luffy`s crew encounters treacherous birds and man-eating foliage on its desert odyssey, and just when they think the coast is clear, a great disturbance emerges from beneath the sand!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 98
dub.description:
The Straw Hats cross paths with the Barbar Sand Pirates, and Ace runs into big trouble when he gets separated from the group.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 99
dub.description:
Princess Vivi devises a plan to test the hearts of a gang of so-called rebels. They talk a good game, but will their bite measure up to their bark?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 100
dub.description:
The Straw Hats continue their journey to Yuba, where a bittersweet reunion with a childhood friend awaits Princess Vivi.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 101
dub.description:
Fire Fist Ace is hired by two young boys to hunt down and capture a lethal bounty hunter known only as the Scorpion.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 102
dub.description:
Chopper, Zoro, and Luffy get separate from the others. When the heat makes Luffy act even stranger than usual, his friends wonder if they joined the right pirate gang.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 103
dub.description:
The assassins of Baroque Works gather at Spider`s Cafe, and the Straw Hats arrive at Yuba only to find it buried in sand.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 104
dub.description:
Crocodile reveals himself to the Baroque Works assassins and discloses his dastardly plan for Alabasta. After departing Yuba, Luffy takes a stand that forces Vivi to rethink her mission.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 105
dub.description:
Vivi takes Luffy`s advice, and the Straw Hats head towards Rainbase for a confrontation with Crocodile. Karoo finally reaches the palace with Vivi`s warning for King Cobra.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 106
dub.description:
Luffy leads a daring - but foolish - raid on Crocodile`s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker - and more importantly, leaves Vivi unprotected.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 107
dub.description:
While the Straw Hats are stuck in the clink, King Cobra addresses the starving people of Nanohana. Will his unbelievable revelation drive his subjects past the brink of rebellion?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 108
dub.description:
A royal impostor has the rebel army hell-bent on bringing Cobra`s reign to a violent end. Meanwhile, Luffy and his mates find themselves in deep trouble and even deeper water.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 109
dub.description:
Sanji shows up in the nick of time to make the crocs cough up the key to Luffy`s freedom, but the ravenous reptiles spit up something else instead.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 110
dub.description:
Crocodile snatches Vivi off the back of a giant crab, but Luffy`s not having it. The rubber-man goes toe-to-toe with the sandman in a battle that will end in bloodshed.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 111
dub.description:
Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 112
dub.description:
Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 113
dub.description:
Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna`s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 114
dub.description:
Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy`s weakness.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 115
dub.description:
Chopper`s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 116
dub.description:
Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; and Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 117
dub.description:
Things don`t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami`s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 118
dub.description:
Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact`s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 119
dub.description:
Zoro hopes to attain a new level of strength when he fights a foe with a body made of blades. The Straw Hat sword-slinger is determined to become a man who can cut steel - or die trying.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 120
dub.description:
Koza - the leader of the rebel army - finally discovers the evil mastermind behind Alabasta`s drought, but is he too late to prevent further bloodshed?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 121
dub.description:
When Koza is mysteriously shot, the rebellion is reborn, but Vivi`s cries for a cease fire fall on deaf ears until a long-overdue hero swoops to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 122
dub.description:
Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won`t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 123
dub.description:
While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country`s greatest secret.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 124
dub.description:
With the walls crumbling down around them, Crocodile attacks Luffy with a poisoned pirate hook. Meanwhile, Vivi draws a bead on the bombers, but can she stop them in time?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 125
dub.description:
The Straw Hats team up to give Vivi one last shot at disarming the bomb that threatens to destroy her city. She succeeds in cutting the fuse, but Crocodile has a backup plan.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 126
dub.description:
Pell`s sacrifice spares his beloved city, but only an act of god can stop the rebellion. With Crocodile`s poison coursing through his body, Luffy musters a final attack against Alabasta`s oppressor.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 127
dub.description:
Crocodile is defeated, the rain has returned to Alabasta, and Vivi`s people are eager to rebuild their kingdom. As for the Straw Hats, they have a fleet of marines breathing down their necks.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 128
dub.description:
Now that the rebellion is over, Vivi must make an important decision about her future. The Straw Hats are ready to hoist the anchor, but an ambiguous villain has stolen the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 129
dub.description:
Mr. 2 is a man of many faces, but he finally shows his true colors when the marines attack the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, Vivi has a scheme up her sleeve, and it involves Igaram wearing a dress.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 130
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew watch Alabasta fade into the distance, but there`s no time for reminiscing. The marines are in hot pursuit, and there`s a stowaway aboard the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 131
dub.description:
Fresh off their adventure Alabasta, the Straw Hats discover an isolated island where they can restock their food supply. Chopper is left to guard the ship, but he and Nico spend the afternoon exploring instead!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 132
dub.description:
When a mail-order salesman gets lost at sea, Nami finds the paper she needs to start making maps. If the Straw Hat crew can somehow manage to survive a deadly cyclone, she might actually get some use out of it!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 133
dub.description:
Heavy fog leads to a close encounter of the culinary kind when Nico fishes a marine out of the drink. The aspiring chef is concerned about the quality of his curry, and Sanji is just the guy to refine his recipe!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 134
dub.description:
A break in the rain provides the perfect opportunity for Usopp to help a young girl fulfill her dream of launching the world`s largest firework.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 135
dub.description:
Money troubles force Zoro to tangle with Dick the Bandit and his treacherous gang of thugs. These gun-toting outlaws are terrorizing a peaceful village, and the Straw Hat swordsman aims to stop their reign of terror!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 136
dub.description:
A barrage of Marine cannon balls forces the Straw Hats to seek refuge on an uncharted island. Once ashore, the crew encounters a strange old man living amongst a herd of goats.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 137
dub.description:
Old man Zenny made a fortune lending money to scallywags, but he always dreamed of becoming a pirate himself. When the marines set out to trap the Straw Hats, the wily hermit may finally get his wish!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 138
dub.description:
Zenny gets more than he bargained for when he embarks on his maiden pirate voyage. The Straw Hats may have made a friend for life, but what are they gonna do about those pesky marines?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 139
dub.description:
