The Straw Hats stop for supplies at a harbor town plagued by a mayor who taxes anything and everything. Over lunch, Luffy and Nico befriend a kooky scientist who`s obsessed with the Rainbow Mist.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 140
dub.description:
Luffy, Usopp, Nico, and Zoro get trapped in the Rainbow Mist along with Henzo. The aging scientist is looking for answers, the Straw Hats want treasure, and the ghosts who haunt the mist want them all to leave!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 141
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew search for a way out of Ape`s Concert, but the Rainbow Mist is an inescapable maze of madness. Back on shore, Nami, Chopper, and Sanji face a lifetime of hard labor for failing to pay their taxes!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 142
dub.description:
Nami enters the mist on a mission to save her mates - and maybe hunt for treasure while she`s at it. The local mayor wants her dead, but the Straw Hats are being protected by a mysterious marine.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 143
dub.description:
The showdown with Mayor Wetton builds towards an explosive finale as the Straw Hats scramble to escape the Rainbow Mist - or be trapped inside forever.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 144
dub.description:
The Straw Hats are nearly crushed by the falling wreckage of a ship that`s over 200 years old. Could rumors of a floating island in the sky be true? Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji go scuba diving to find out!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 145
dub.description:
Still searching for a route to the island in the sky, the Straw Hats chart a course for Jaya. Meanwhile, Fire-Fist Ace crashes a party aboard a vessel helmed by Buggy the Pirate!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 146
dub.description:
The Straw Hats drop anchor at a town overrun by scallywags, so Nami makes the boys swear to stay out of trouble. But when the Bellamy Pirates come looking for a fight, Luffy may have to break his promise!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 147
dub.description:
Nico`s handy work unearths a solitary dreamer who may know the way to Sky Island. All Luffy and his crew have to do is survive the sonic onslaught of simian salvagers seeking to sink the Going Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 148
dub.description:
Luffy and his mates reach the home of Mont Blanc Cricket: the man with the key to reaching Sky Island. There`s just one tiny problem - he comes from a long line of legendary liars.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 149
dub.description:
Montblanc Cricket agrees to help the Straw Hats reach Sky Island, but first they must venture deep into the darkest depths of a spider-infested forest to capture a mysterious bird with a keen sense of direction.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 150
dub.description:
While the Straw Hats battle creepy-crawly forest creatures on their quest to capture a South Bird, Mont Blanc and his monkey minions are brutally attacked by the Bellamy Pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 151
dub.description:
Luffy turned the other cheek during his first encounter with Bellamy, but now he`s out to settle the score for old man Mont Blanc. Meanwhile, a fearsome pirate crew takes aim at the Straw Hats, eager to earn a bad reputation!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 152
dub.description:
Thanks to some modifications to the Going Merry, the Straw Hats are on their way to that island in the sky! But with the Blackbeard Pirates in hot pursuit, navigating the vertical currents will be anything but easy.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 153
dub.description:
Reaching the sea of clouds proves easier than surviving in it when giant sea creatures attack the Going Merry, Usopp nearly drowns in a cloud, and a strange sky knight issues the Straw Hats a warning!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 154
dub.description:
After hitching a ride on a speedy shrimp, the Straw Hats reach the land of Skypiea! The intrepid pirates have much to learn about their new surroundings, but a beautiful angel makes a perfect tour guide.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 155
dub.description:
Nami`s eagerness to explore the forbidden realm of Upper Yard brings her face to face with the wrath of god, and the Straw Hats incur Heaven`s Judgment for failing to pay their immigration fees!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 156
dub.description:
The Straw Hats are no strangers to living on the wrong side of the law, but unpaid immigration fees and Nami`s assault of a White Beret earns Luffy`s crew a sentence of death by cloud drifting!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 157
dub.description:
Nami, Zoro, Chopper, and Robin are trapped aboard the Going Merry when it`s commandeered by a monstrous lobster! To rescue his crew, Luffy must venture onto the sacred grounds of Upper Yard!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 158
dub.description:
Conis helps Luffy and his mates launch their rescue mission, but the rubber-man senses something amiss. When he presses her for answers, a vengeful god takes a shot at the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 159
dub.description:
Zoro dukes it out with a hungry Skyshark in the shadow of the Sacrificial Alter. On the other side of Upper Yard, Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp try to survive their visit to an island that wants them dead!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 160
dub.description:
Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp tangle with Satori and his exploding, snake-filled Surprise Clouds. The sky priest may look like a dancing dango, but the impact of his mantra leaves the pirates bloodied and boatless.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 161
dub.description:
Usopp and Sanji try to regain control of the Crow, and Luffy stirs up a brutal barrage of bursting balls when he attacks Satori. Meanwhile, Chopper whistles for the Sky Knight to avoid becoming a sacrificial reindeer!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 162
dub.description:
Chopper fights bravely to stop Shura from incinerating the Going Merry, but the little reindeer is no match for a sky priest. Gan Fall is on his way, but will the dispossessed deity arrive in time?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 163
dub.description:
When Gan Fall is badly burned during his battle with Shura, Chopper musters the courage for a death-defying leap of faith. Elsewhere, Luffy may have finally discovered a way to defeat Satori!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 164
dub.description:
The Shandorians prepare for an all-out attack on their priestly adversaries, Chopper meets the mysterious creatures that saved his life, and Nami makes an astonishing discovery about the origins of Upper Yard.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 165
dub.description:
While the Shandorians continue their battle for control of Upper Yard, the Straw Hats celebrate their happy reunion by swapping stories over a campfire and feasting on barbequed Skyshark!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 166
dub.description:
Laki`s pursuit of precious Vearth causes one of her Shandorian comrades to be injured during the battle with Ohm. As night falls on Upper Yard, the Straw Hats dream of gold while dancing with wolves!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 167
dub.description:
The electrifying deity of Skypiea, God Eneru, grants his priests unlimited power in their hunt for the Straw Hats. Usopp has a plan to get the mysteriously-repaired Going Merry back in the water, but it involves using Chopper as bait!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 168
dub.description:
The Straw Hats scatter when their search for gold uncovers a giant python, and Gan Fall reveals the tragic story of Jaya`s arrival in the sky. Meanwhile, Wyper readies the Shandorians for a raid on Eneru`s shrine!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 169
dub.description:
As the heartless god of Upper Yard eagerly anticipates the dawning of Sky Warefare, the Shandorian forces are savagely snared by the Ordeal of String, and Luffy wanders into the fight of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 170
dub.description:
Zoro rushes to perfect a deadly technique known as the Flying Blade Attack. The move proves difficult to master, but it could be the key to the swordsman surviving a battle with the Shandorian warrior, Braham.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 171
dub.description:
Sanji and Usopp are driven to their knees by the electrifying presence of god, Luffy is nearly incinerated by Wyper`s Burn Bazooka, and Nami joins Gan Fall in a fight against two killer clones!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 172
dub.description:
Chopper unleashes the fury of his Rumble Ball during a sticky slugfest with a swap cloud spewing priest of Upper Yard. Can the little reindeer discover his opponent`s lone weakness before it`s too late?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 173
dub.description:
Nami and the Knight of the Sky team up to obliterate two bumbling, balloon-shaped bad guys, and God Eneru relies on his astounding invincibility to torment a noble Shandorian warrior.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 174
dub.description:
Robin`s search for a mystical city of gold is interrupted by Yama, one of Eneru`s faithful servants. When the rampaging warrior destroys some ancient ruins, he provokes the wrath of Robin`s many fists of fury!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 175
dub.description:
Priest Ohm silences Chopper with an attack from which few - if any - ever recover. Meanwhile, Luffy begins to notice something strange about his cave-like prison, and four fearsome warriors prepare for battle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 176
dub.description:
Zoro, Gan Fall, Wyper, Ohm and a prizefighting pooch gather for a ferocious free-for-all at the site of the Upper Ruins. While the battle rages, Luffy tries to punch his way out of the belly of a poisonous python!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 177
dub.description:
Zoro and Wyper are out to beat down the same bad guys, but will they realize it soon enough to survive a white-barbed death match of doom? Deep in the belly of the python, Nami and Luffy enjoy what could be a short-lived reunion!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 178
dub.description:
Eager to end their battle, Zoro aims the awesome destructive power of his 108 Caliber Phoenix at the sinister Priest Ohm! Elsewhere, god demands that Robin help him search for a legendary golden bell.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 179
dub.description:
God Eneru begins a deadly rampage aimed at exterminating the heavenly beings of Skypiea, and the ruins of Shandora become the scene of bloody contest where survival is the name of the game.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 180
dub.description:
Gan Fall, Wyper, Zoro, and Robin join forces for an attack on God Eneru. Despite their furious onslaught, the four warriors prove powerless to harm the thunderous deity until Wyper utilizes the power of a mystical stone!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 181
dub.description:
God Eneru makes a shocking recovery from wounds that should have ended his reign of terror. Zoro and Wyper muster the strength for one final stand, and Nami must choose between her friends - and survival.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 182
dub.description:
Luffy emerges from his serpentine tomb with one thing on his mind: revenge! As the rubber-man sets out to settle the score with God Eneru, Conis rushes to warn her people of their impending doom!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 183
dub.description:
As the citizens of the sky run for their lives, Eneru issues in the dawn of Deathpiea! Luffy is determined to stop the madman, but first he must discover a way to lay hands on the heinous holy man!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 184
dub.description:
A handful of gold sends Luffy hurtling towards his death, Sanji and Usopp mount a midair rescue mission, and Nami prepares for an electrifying showdown with God Eneru!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 185
dub.description:
Usopp arrives just in time to save Nami from a lethal thunderbolt, but even their combined powers are no match for Eneru. While they scramble for an escape route, Sanji stealthily searches for a way to sabotage god`s ark!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 186
dub.description:
Despite being slowed by an arm encased in gold, Luffy races up a giant beanstalk on a mission to settle the score with Eneru! Elsewhere, the people of Skypiea feel the jolt of god`s wrath!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 187
dub.description:
A flashback offers a glimpse at that lives of two legendary figures in Skypiea`s history: Montblanc Noland and the ferocious warrior Kalgara!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 188
dub.description:
The look back at the legend of Montblanc Noland and Kalgara the warrior continues with the story of how these two very different men suddenly found friendship - and then lost it just as quickly!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 189
dub.description:
Montblanc Noland and the warrior Kalgara succeed in settling their difference before parting ways, but the laws of nature and man conspire to keep them apart - permanently!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 190
dub.description:
Eneru strikes Angel Island with a devastating lightning bolt, and Luffy continues his heroic climb up the giant beanstalk. The rubber-man refuses to stop until he rings the golden bell - no matter what the cost!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 191
dub.description:
While Eneru continues his thunderous barrage, Nami hatches a plan to give Luffy one more shot at a grudge match with god. Zoro`s at the center of the scheme, but he might not survive his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 192
dub.description:
Nami`s quick thinking gets Luffy closer to god, and the Straw Hat captain launches himself into the center of a sinister storm! Can he find a way to destroy Eneru`s looming cloud of death?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 193
dub.description:
In the aftermath of Luffy`s epic battle with Eneru, sunny skies chase away the storms, and the cloud-dwelling citizens of Angel Island turn their attention to rebuilding their homeland.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 194
dub.description:
Robin attempts to decipher the riddle of a mysterious poneglyph, Usopp barters with the locals, and Luffy raids the priceless treasures of the legendary city of gold!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 195
dub.description:
With a little help from their new friends - and a giant octopus - the Straw Hats bid farewell to Skypiea and begin their decent back to the deep blue sea. Where they`ll land is anyone`s guess!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 196
dub.description:
After a frightening fall from the clouds, the Straw Hats find themselves trapped inside an impenetrable Marine stronghold. The crew gets separated, the Going Merry is impounded, and rumors of ghosts run rampant!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 197
dub.description:
While Nami searches for the Going Merry, Luffy and Sanji pose as famous chefs, only to end up competing in a cooking contest with a beautiful mistress of the galley!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 198
dub.description:
Zoro is imprisoned and interrogated, and Chopper`s ill-chosen hiding spot lands him in the operating room along with a doctor who can`t stand the sight of blood!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 199
dub.description:
Luffy`s insatiable appetite betrays his true identity, and yet another member of his crew ends up in the brig when two Straw Hats try to fool Commander Jonathan with the same disguise!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 200
dub.description:
Commander Jonathan sets a Straw Hat trap, but Luffy and Sanji are willing to risk it all to help spring their mates. Will a souvenir from the sky save the day - or will their escape plan be scuttled by foul play?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 201
dub.description:
Luffy and his gang make a break for the docks, and Commander Jonathan deploys armed guards in an attempt to slow down the Straw Hats. Only one thing is certain: somebody is going down for the count!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 202
dub.description:
The Straw Hats are surrounded, outnumbered, blasted with tear gas. Taking a pretty, young doctor hostage may be their only hope for surviving long enough for a Merry reunion!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 203
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew were almost in the clear when Nami made a horrifying discovery: the Marines stole their gold! Now, the Straw Hats must sail straight into the thick of the fight to reclaim their lost riches!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 204
dub.description:
Usopp hatches a plan for a moonlit raid on the Marine vault, but Commander Jonathan is has a nasty surprise waiting for the pirates! Meanwhile, Sanji and Nami attempt to recover the waver.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 205
dub.description:
The extreme arrogance of a Marine special investigator clears a path for Luffy and company to make their escape! Unfortunately, the Straw Hats still have to find their gold before returning to the high seas!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 206
dub.description:
The Straw Hats may think they`re in the clear, but Commander Jonathan has one final trap waiting to ground the Going Merry! If Luffy`s crew is to escape, they`ll need a helping hand - or eight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 207
dub.description:
Luffy and his mates survive and near-death encounter with some mischievous sea monkeys only to land on a mysterious island where everything is much longer than it should be!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 208
dub.description:
After a loyal horse and his recently-returned master are assaulted by thugs, Luffy is drawn into a Davy Back Fight with the Foxy Pirates. The Straw Hat captain never backs down from a challenge, but this contest could cost him his crew!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 209
dub.description:
The Davy Back Fight begins with a treacherous Donut Race around Ling Ring Long Land! The Straw Hats square off against the Foxy Pirates in a battle to see who loses a crew member!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 210
dub.description:
Nami uses her considerable skill as a navigator to put the Straw Hats on the verge of victory, but the captain of the Foxy Pirates has more than a few dirty tricks up his sleeve!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 211
dub.description:
Thanks to some foxy sabotage, Chopper has been lost to the enemy. The only hope for getting him back lies with Zoro and Sanji, but can they learn to work together in time to save the little reindeer?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 212
dub.description:
Sanji and Zoro take a beating at the hands of the Groggy Monsters, but they won`t give up the fight. With a little luck – and some teamwork - they`ll emerge victorious from round two of the Davy Back Fight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 213
dub.description:
Round three of the Davy Back Fight is a rip roaring roller derby! Chopper`s fate still hangs in the balance, and the Straw Hats have a huge problem: Luffy doesn`t know how to skate!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 214
dub.description:
As the Davy Back Fight sprints toward a sensational finish, the Straw Hats find themselves on the brink of defeat! Luffy`s finally managed to stay on his skates, but the Foxy Pirates are notorious cheaters!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 215
dub.description:
The Straw Hats somehow manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates and win back Chopper, but Luffy eagerly accepts the challenge of a rematch! What is the captain thinking? And will his crew mutiny?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 216
dub.description:
A devious game of dodge ball costs the Straw Hats their archaeologist. Now, they`ll have to win an unusual uphill race to reclaim Robin and avoid losing another crew member!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 217
dub.description:
Robin and Chopper have both been lost to the Foxy Pirates, and there`s only one match remaining in the Davy Back Fight! Luffy`s got a plan to get his mates back, but failure would mean the end of the Straw Hats forever!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 218
dub.description:
Luffy and Captain Foxy go toe-to-toe in a brutal battle waged aboard a booby trapped boat. Luffy is fighting for his crew, but Captain Foxy`s dirty tricks have him on the ropes!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 219
dub.description:
Luffy`s epic battle with Captain Foxy reaches its riveting end, and a very old man with a very tall horse reunites with a face from very long ago.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 220
dub.description:
When Luffy and his mates lose their memory, Robin is the only Straw Hat who can remember their adventures together. Can she can she recover their recollections before the crew splits up?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 221
dub.description:
Robin tries to hold the crew together while unraveling the mystery of the missing memories. Meanwhile, Nami and Zoro flashback to painful moments from their pasts.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 222
dub.description:
The Straw Hats finally discover the culprit behind their memory loss, but they`ve got bigger problems. The mysterious thief is determined to pit Zoro and Luffy against each other!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 223
dub.description:
Zoro and Luffy fight to the death, Nami attempts to orchestrate an uprising, and Sanji discovers he`s willing to kick a kid in order to get his memories back!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 224
dub.description:
The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 225
dub.description:
A terrible storm leads to another run in with the devious Captain Foxy! When Luffy makes the dangerous decision to help his old foe, it could spell disaster for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 226
dub.description:
Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard the Captain Foxy`s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse is awaits them!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 227
dub.description:
The Straw Hats take time out to help a group of hungry castaways, but trouble looms on the horizon. An icy marine adversary is out to track down Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 228
dub.description:
Chopper and Usopp work feverishly to save Robin from her icy tomb, and Luffy looks to settle the score with Admiral Aokiji in a man-to-man fight to the finish!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 229
dub.description:
An encounter with a giant swimming frog leads to a close call with a seafaring train! Next up for the Straw Hats: drop anchor at a town full of water and seek out a shipwright!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 230
dub.description:
Luffy, Usopp, and Nami take a wild ride through Water Seven in search of a shipwright. Meanwhile, Chopper and Robin get separate during their quest to find a bookstore!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 231
dub.description:
Zoro is attacked by thugs who want to cash in on his bounty, Sanji gets lost on a grocery shopping expedition, and three suitcases full of cash mysteriously go missing!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 232
dub.description:
A carpenter and his talking pigeon help recover the Straw Hats` missing money, but the Franky Family won`t give up so easily. Luffy and Nami receive very bad news about their beloved boat!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 233
dub.description:
Luffy and Nami refuse to believe that the Going Merry`s seaworthy days are finished, but for now, bigger problems loom on the horizon! Their money is missing again, along with Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 234
dub.description:
Usopp bravely tries to recover the stolen money, but the Franky Family has him badly outnumbered. Zoro, Sanji, and Chopper set out on a rescue mission, but they`ll need Luffy to even the odds!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 235
dub.description:
Usopp regains consciousness after his vicious beating, but he`s not at all happy to hear Luffy`s plans for the Going Merry. Temper flares and challenges are issued as the Straw Hats face their most uncertain hour.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 236
dub.description:
Luffy and Usopp battle to a brutal standstill in a heartbreaking duel between men who once called each other family. Can the Straw Hats find the strength to carry on without their sniper?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 237
dub.description:
The Straw Hat split is overshadowed by an assassination attempt on the mayor of Water Seven! Luffy is eager to investigate, but the leader of the Franky Family is about to reappear!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 238
dub.description:
Luffy`s grudge match with Franky gets serious when his opponent turns out to be a cyborg! Iceberg awakes from his slumber only to hurl heinous accusations at the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 239
dub.description:
Luffy is branded an assassin and attacked by Iceberg`s strongest men! Meanwhile, Sanji and Chopper attempt to warn Usopp about an impending natural disaster!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 240
dub.description:
The citizens of Water Seven search for the Straw Hats, and a devastating storm threatens to sink the city. Chopper and Sanji pick up Robin`s trail, but they aren`t prepared for what they`ll find.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 241
dub.description:
Usopp prepares to ride out the storm aboard the Going Merry, Franky hatches a plan to force Luffy into a rematch, and the Straw Hats set out to uncover Robin`s dark secret.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 242
dub.description:
Robin and her CP9 brethren seek to settle unfinished business with Iceberg. The Straw Hats have a plan to clear their names, but the assassins are one step ahead of them.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 243
dub.description:
Luffy makes his long awaited entrance, Iceberg has a shocking surprise in store for Robin, and the true identities of the masked assassins of CP9 are finally revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 244
dub.description:
CP9 listens to Iceberg`s blood to learn to the location of the blueprints, Usopp has another run in with Franky, and the remaining Straw Hats – plus a new friend – race to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 245
dub.description:
Luffy and the gang come face to face with Robin and her CP9 comrades. The rubberman is prepared to fight for his friend, but he`s never faced foes like this!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 246
dub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, and Nami are sent hurtling toward their deaths by the villains of CP9! Meanwhile, Usopp forges an unlikely friendship with Franky while waiting out a storm.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 247
dub.description:
Franky tries to convince Usopp that there`s no hope for the Going Merry, but the sniper - inspired by a mysterious moment from the past - remains loyal to his beloved boat
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 248
dub.description:
A look back at Franky`s past reveals the amazing origins of the sea train – and paints a vivid picture of his younger days, spent alongside Iceberg and the legendary shipwright Tom!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 249
dub.description:
Franky`s backstory continues! The sea train is a success, and it looks like Tom`s life is spared! Unfortunately, a government spy is searching for a reason to investigate Tom, and Franky provides the ammunition!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 250
dub.description:
Tom does the unthinkable in an attempt to protect his apprentices, but young Franky is unable to control his rage, leading to a showdown with a spy - and a train!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 251
dub.description:
Chopper`s heroism may mean the difference between life and death for Iceberg and Paulie, Nami learns the agonizing truth about Robin, and Sanji prepares to make his move!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 252
dub.description:
Nami makes a frantic dash for the Sea Train station, Chopper searches desperately for Zoro and Luffy, and Sanji plays it cool while waiting for the right time to spring into action.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 253
dub.description:
Nami arrives at the train station a minute too late, Sanji makes his presence aboard the sea train known, and the search for Luffy and Zoro continues!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 254
dub.description:
Chopper and Nami risk their own lives in a desperate attempt to save Luffy and Zoro from a monstrous wall of water! Meanwhile, Sanji moves ever closer to a reunion with Robin.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 255
dub.description:
Luffy and Nami ask to borrow a ship so they can chase down the sea train, but the weather is too severe to set sail. Lucky for them, Iceberg and his friends are full of surprises!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 256
dub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, Chopper, and Nami rocket toward a rendezvous with the assassins of CP 9, but they`ll need to forge an alliance with some new friends to have any chance at survival!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 257
dub.description:
Zoro and Luffy go head-to-head with Mother Nature, and Sanji`s rescue mission is bolstered by Franky`s allegiance – and the arrival of the mysterious Sniper King!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 258
dub.description:
Sniper King, a mysterious warrior from the island of snipers, lends a hand as Franky and Sanji try to fight their way to Robin.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 259
dub.description:
Sanji mixes it up with a deranged cook, Franky dukes it out with the newest member of CP9, and the Sniper King gets creative in his attempt to reach Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 260
dub.description:
Franky and Sanji continue to battle the thugs of CP9. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the gang find themselves headed for a collision that could spell doom for everyone!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 261
dub.description:
Zoro faces a fellow master of the blade, Sanji looks to end his fight with against a rampaging ramen master, and Franky finally lands a big blow against his CP9 foe!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 262
dub.description:
The Sniper King hatches a daring escape plan, but the assassins of CP9 are more powerful than our heroes ever imagined. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang run into a very familiar frog!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.description:
A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 394
dub.description:
Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 395
dub.description:
With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 396
dub.description:
Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed celestial dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 397
dub.description:
Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a celestial dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 398
dub.description:
They saved Cami from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass Captain Kid and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 399
dub.description:
The Straw Hats join forces with Kid’s crew and Trafalgar’s mates to make short work of the marines, but they’re in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 400
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh’s house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger’s ship.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 401
dub.description:
Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 402
dub.description:
A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a warlord lookalike.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 403
dub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far more deadly foe comes looking for a fight.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 404
dub.description:
Zoro’s barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 405
dub.description:
One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 406
dub.description:
Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a warlord of the sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 407
dub.description:
Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 408
dub.description:
Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man’s amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 409
dub.description:
An army of scantily-clad Amazonian warriors want to investigate Luffy’s family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 410
dub.description:
The Amazonians chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she’s about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 411
dub.description:
Luffy’s search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a “drop-in” on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 412
dub.description:
Boa Hancock makes Luffy fighting mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging captain Straw Hat!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 413
dub.description:
The Snake Princess pits Luffy’s Gum Gum abilities against the incredible Haki Power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 414
dub.description:
Luffy kicks his attack mode into second gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle’s climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 415
dub.description:
News of Luffy’s run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 416
dub.description:
Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty amazons eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 417
dub.description:
Boa Hancock`s illness threatens to sabotage Luffy`s rescue mission; however, the Snake Princess just can`t say "no" to the rubberman, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 418
dub.description:
While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 419
dub.description:
Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji`s refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of "girlish hearts".
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 420
dub.description:
Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 421
dub.description:
Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 422
dub.description:
Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace`s execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 423
dub.description:
Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who`s going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There`s no love lost between Buggy the Clown and the Straw Hat captain, but they`d better work together if they want to survive.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 424
dub.description:
Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down`s Crimson Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 425
dub.description:
Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren`t careful in Impel Down`s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison`s putrid warden!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 426
dub.description:
Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 427
dub.description:
The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 428
dub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 429
dub.description:
Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 430
dub.description:
Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 431
dub.description:
While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 432
dub.description:
Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 433
dub.description:
Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn`t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they`ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 434
dub.description:
Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 435
dub.description:
Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who`s deadly to the touch?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 436
dub.description:
Luffy`s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 437
dub.description:
Luffy is at the end of the line - the only thing that can save him now is true friendship. But in a place like Impel Down can true friendship be found?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 438
dub.description:
No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 439
dub.description:
Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan`s agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 440
dub.description:
Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy`s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 441
dub.description:
Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he`s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission - until he learns of Luffy`s lineage!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 442
dub.description:
The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan`s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 443
dub.description:
Luffy`s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 444
dub.description:
Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard`s arrival leads to the release of the prison`s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 445
dub.description:
Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 446
dub.description:
Luffy`s bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say - heads will roll!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 447
dub.description:
Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard`s vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 448
dub.description:
Ace is to be executed in a matter of hours, and Magellan`s toxic breath is singeing the back of Luffy`s neck. Ivan uses a devastating Death Wink to buy some time, but the warden`s Poison Hydra may be more than he can handle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 449
dub.description:
Luffy dons a suit of waxy armor in preparation for his rematch with Warden Magellan. Outside the prison walls, Jimbei turns a door into a boat, so Crocodile and Buggy can commandeer an escape vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 450
dub.description:
Magellan takes his toxic attack to the next level by unleashing the hideous and deadly Venom Demon! If Jimbei and Crocodile don`t return with a rescue ship soon, Luffy won`t survive long enough to save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 451
dub.description:
Luffy and his merry band of escapees are safely onboard the rescue ship, but they`re not out hot water just yet. A fleet of marines is bombarding them with cannon balls, and an impenetrable gate looms on the horizon!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 452
dub.description:
Luffy and Ivan mourn the loss of Bon Clay, and Captain Buggy`s reputation gets a boost when a phone call from the Marines reveals the secrets of his past.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 453
dub.description:
While Luffy continues his rescue mission, Nami learns a lesson about how to turn rain into cash, and Franky wakes up in a freezing forest full of ferocious cyborg animals!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 454
dub.description:
Sanji tries to fight his way off a most peculiar island, but his frilly battle costume threatens to awaken his inner maiden. Elsewhere, Chopper tries to avoid being served in a hot pot!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 455
dub.description:
Nico Robin lends her many hands to an overmatched gang of revolutionaries in a frigid land of eternal suffering, and Usopp bulks up to avoid becoming a snack for a hungry, hungry island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 456
dub.description:
Zoro`s attempt to reunite with his friends leads him a massive tomb and a host of shadowy swordsmen. Elsewhere, Brook uses his status as Satan to get an eyeful of undergarments!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 457
dub.description:
While the marines prepare for Ace`s execution, Luffy looks back on all the good times he shared with his brother, and Jimbei reveals the shocking details of the day Fire Fist Ace went down in defeat!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 458
dub.description:
Luffy and his gang continue on their way to Marineford, but once he arrives, the rubber-man must defeat both Navy Admirals and Warlords of the Sea before he can save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 459
dub.description:
Citizens and soldiers alike prepare for all-out war as Ace is led to the site of his execution. While the world watches, the true identity of the condemned man`s father is shockingly revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 460
dub.description:
Flashbacks reveal the agonizing sacrifice made by Ace`s mother in order save his life - and the secret behind his connection to Luffy. Back in the present, Whitebeard makes a unexpected entrance!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 461
dub.description:
As a massive seaquake rocks Marineford, Ace recalls the ups and downs of his life as a pirate, including his first encounter with Whitebeard - and the unthinkable betrayal that led to his capture!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 462
dub.description:
Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 463
dub.description:
Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There`s only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 464
dub.description:
A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm`s reach of his friend when he`s intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 465
dub.description:
In the wake of Little Oars Junior`s tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace`s execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 466
dub.description:
Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man`s refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 467
dub.description:
Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 468
dub.description:
Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy`s own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 469
dub.description:
A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san`s Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 470
dub.description:
Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy`s onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren`t ready to give up the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 471
dub.description:
Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 472
dub.description:
Whitebeard is betrayed - and brutally stabbed - by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 473
dub.description:
Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy`s defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 474
dub.description:
With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 475
dub.description:
Crocodile`s unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 476
dub.description:
The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 477
dub.description:
While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a trouble youth spent seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 478
dub.description:
Luffy makes short work of face from his past, and Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner`s swords hovering above Ace`s head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 479
dub.description:
Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises up to derail the rescue mission at the last second!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 480
dub.description:
Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight - his own grandfather - in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won`t be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide back up!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 481
dub.description:
Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 482
dub.description:
Despite Whitebeard`s order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 483
dub.description:
An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 484
dub.description:
Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace`s tragic death. Luffy - paralyzed by grief - must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 485
dub.description:
Whitebeard’s children watch in horror as the old man faces off the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never, ever runs away from a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 486
dub.description:
The world reacts to Whitebeard`s death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy and Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 487
dub.description:
While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy`s desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu`s fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 488
dub.description:
Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route, Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-hair marine changes the world with a scream!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 489
dub.description:
The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 490
dub.description:
The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard`s death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy`s friends fear that Ace`s death may be more than the rubber-man can handle - if he ever wakes up!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 491
dub.description:
Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard, and Luffy`s nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 492
dub.description:
One Piece X Toriko Crossover
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 493
dub.description:
A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 494
dub.description:
The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 495
dub.description:
Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight - even when he`s outnumbered!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 496
dub.description:
When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend`s past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates, and hoist a toast to brotherhood!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 497
dub.description:
After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 498
dub.description:
Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that`s been stealing their food, Ace gets angry when his father`s identity is revealed, and Sabo`s parents hire pirates to track down their son!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 499
dub.description:
Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeating the big tiger - and becoming a good captian!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 500
dub.description:
The brothers are captured by a gang of pirates, and Sabo is handed over to his noble father, where the boy quickly discovers a sinister plot to destroy Gray Terminal forever!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 501
dub.description:
While flames spread across Gray Terminal, Sabo makes a desperate attempt to escape the trappings of his noble birth and save his brothers. Meanwhile, Luffy and Ace must fight to avoid an untimely end!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 502
dub.description:
Luffy is spared from a fiery death by an unlikely rescuer, but Ace refuses to leave Gray Terminal until he settles the score with Bluejam. Meanwhile, Sabo makes waves with a last ditch escape attempt!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 503
dub.description:
Luffy and Ace receive troubling reports of a Celestial attack on Sabo`s ship. Ace is eager to seek out the responsible parties and extract revenge, but a letter from his absent brother tempers his eagerness to fight!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 504
dub.description:
In the wake of Sabo`s death, Luffy and Ace grow stronger than ever by continuing their daily routine of nonstop fighting. As the years pass, each brother prepares to set sail in search of future adventures!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 505
dub.description:
Garp takes a beating from a heartbroken mountain bandit, and a big, blue friend helps Luffy drown his despair in the newfound desire to reunite with his mates!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 506
dub.description:
One by one, the Straw Hats are crushed to learn the tragic fate of Fire Fist Ace. Despite their own unique problems, the crew members` thoughts immediately turn to their crestfallen captain.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 507
dub.description:
Luffy is determined to reassemble his scattered crew, but a powerful old friend forces him to rethink his plans. Meanwhile, Usopp fights to escape an island that wants to have him for lunch!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 508
dub.description:
Desperate to reach Luffy, Nami risks her life to escape from an island of weather wizards. Meanwhile, Franky rides a carbonation high through the ice and snow in search of a seaworthy vessel!

Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 630
dub.description:
The Straw Hats and their friends set out to explore Dressrosa, a land full of beautiful women, delicious food, and live toys that walk amongst the living.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 631
dub.description:
A blind warrior lays a beat down on a gang of masked thugs, Zorro chases the thief who stole his sword, and Luffy finds himself tempted by the promise of a fiery fruit!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 632
dub.description:
Zoro continues his hunt for the fairy who stole his sword, Sanji is smitten by a beautiful dancer, and Luffy prepares to fight for the Devil Fruit that belonged to his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 633
dub.description:
Sanji falls further under the spell of his new lady friend, and Luffy makes quite an impression as he gets to know the fighters competing for Ace`s Devil Fruit.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 634
dub.description:
A gorgeous gladiator tells Luffy the story of the world`s greatest warrior, a masked mauler literally destroys the competition, and the Navy makes its presence felt!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 635
dub.description:
An old nemesis sees through Luffy`s disguise, Zoro finally catches up to the sword-stealing fairy, and Sanji`s skill at sniffing out snipers impresses his new lady friend!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 636
dub.description:
Bartolomeo and Bellamy take center stage in the latest round of the battle royal, but a slugger with a serious punch threatens to steal their thunder. Meanwhile, Luffy is targeted by an angry behemoth!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 637
dub.description:
An old enemy of Garp`s reveals Luffy`s true identity, landing the Straw Hat captain in hot water with one of his fellow competitors. Meanwhile, the battle in Block B gets supremely brutal!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 638
dub.description:
Franky`s new robot friend promises to reveal the tragic secrets of Dressrosa, and a regal brawler prepares to throw a powerful punch that could destroy the entire colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 639
dub.description:
While Law, Robin, Usopp, and Caesar attempt to survive a Fighting Fish attack, Sanji learns the heartbreaking truth about the beautiful woman who stole his heart!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 640
dub.description:
Luffy`s turn to fight in the epic colosseum battle draws near, Zoro has an interesting encounter with a surprisingly strong fairy, and the thoughts in Sanji`s head shock his lady captor!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 641
dub.description:
Sanji learns some disturbing news that could mean trouble for his friends, Luffy prepares for a fight, and Robin is captured by a village full of little people!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 642
dub.description:
Despite Sanji`s attempt to warn him, Law finds his life in danger after being ambushed by Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Luffy is unable to hide his true identity once the fists start flying!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 643
dub.description:
After his plan falls apart, Law must fight for his life against two powerful opponents. Elsewhere, Sanji bids a touching goodbye to his special lady friend, and Luffy tangles with Brutal Bull!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 644
dub.description:
Nami, Chopper, and Brook are grotesquely transformed by a hideous woman who fancies herself an artist. Back at the colosseum, Luffy gets serious when his new friend falls victim to a giant attack!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 645
dub.description:
Zoro and his fairy friend argue over directions, Trafalgar Law finds himself outnumbered in his battle with Doflamingo, and Luffy`s latest opponent packs an explosive punch!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 646
dub.description:
While Nami, Chopper, and Brook attempt to take back the Sunny, Luffy and the monstrous mauler Don Chinjao take their brutal grudge match to a legendary level!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 647
dub.description:
Luffy`s battle with Don Chinjao heats up, Franky learns the tragic truth behind Dressrosa`s mysterious toy population, and Robin and Usopp prepare to join their little friends in battle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 648
dub.description:
Luffy continues his battle with Don Chinjao, Franky and Zoro are reunited in the land of the little people, and Law is wounded in a revealing, face-to-face showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 649
dub.description:
A flashback reveals the story of how Garp changed Chinjao`s world forever. Back in the present, Luffy and his opponent trade ferocious blows that literally rock the colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 650
dub.description:
During a break between battles, Luffy is attacked by an angry rival, but a beautiful gladiator with mysterious motives offers him food - and a place to rest.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 651
dub.description:
In the moments before battle, the beautiful gladiator Rebecca flashes back to the tragic events of her childhood and the toy soldier who became her constant companion.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 652
dub.description:
The bloodthirsty crowd hurls insults at Rebecca as the battle of Block D begins. On the other side of the island, Law finds himself on the losing end of his battle with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 653
dub.description:
Brook`s trickery springs the Straw Hats from their artistic prison, but their failure to cuff the culprit means they`ll need help from a cola-powered cannon to emerge victorious!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 654
dub.description:
Cavendish wins over the female fans during the Block D battle, Luffy keeps an eye on Rebecca, and Sanji heads toward a heated collision with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 655
dub.description:
Sanji`s battle with Doflamingo is interrupted by Law`s sudden arrival, and Rebecca continues her impressive showing in the battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 656
dub.description:
Law begins a deadly, face-to-face battle with Doflamingo, Zoro enlists the aid of a star struck gladiator, and Rebecca continues to impresses Luffy with her unique fighting style!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 657
dub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 658
dub.description:
Rebecca`s battle continues, a madman turns a gladiator into a play thing, and the brave little toy soldier reveals his painful past – and the tragic truth behind King Riku`s fall from power!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 659
dub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 660
dub.description:
Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 661
dub.description:
Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 662
dub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 663
dub.description:
Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 664
dub.description:
Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 665
dub.description:
Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 666
dub.description:
Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 667
dub.description:
Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 668
dub.description:
Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 669
dub.description:
Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 670
dub.description:
Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 671
dub.description:
Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 672
dub.description:
The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier’s stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 673
dub.description:
Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 674
dub.description:
With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 675
dub.description:
The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 676
dub.description:
In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 677
dub.description:
Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 678
dub.description:
Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo’s clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 679
dub.description:
Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 680
dub.description:
The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 681
dub.description:
As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 682
dub.description:
Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 683
dub.description:
Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 684
dub.description:
With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 685
dub.description:
Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica’s giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 686
dub.description:
Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 687
dub.description:
Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 688
dub.description:
Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 689
dub.description:
Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 690
dub.description:
The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 691
dub.description:
Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 692
dub.description:
The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 693
dub.description:
Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 694
dub.description:
Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 695
dub.description:
Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 696
dub.description:
Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo -- but Sugar stands in their way!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 697
dub.description:
Usopp uses Viola`s Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster -- and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp`s ammunition has been specially designed for this specific situation!
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 698
dub.description:
The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy`s own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 699
dub.description:
All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora’s true intention…
Source: crunchyroll

dub.title: Episode 700
dub.description:
